sentences.en: I leaned closer and heard it — a low hum rising from the soil like a held breath.
sentences.cn: 我凑近了，听到了——一阵低鸣从土壤里升起，就像一口被屏住的呼吸。

national:1.en: At the great gate of the Cloud Sea Sect, banners from every peak hung side by side. Xiaoxing told me this was a *national* gathering of all mountain sects, held once each generation. Disciples from distant peaks filled the stone plaza, their robes carrying colors I had never seen. The air hummed with a hundred different words at once.
national:1.cnHint: 弟子在宗门大门前得知，这是一次____范围内的聚会。
national:1.hook: Among the distant faces, one wore no sect color at all.
national:1.line: 'This *national* gathering only happens when the heavens send a warning,' said Xiaoxing.

sentences.en: At the great gate of the Cloud Sea Sect, banners from every peak hung side by side.
sentences.cn: 云海宗的大门前，各峰的旗幡并排高悬。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing told me this was a *national* gathering of all mountain sects, held once each generation.
Disciples from distant peaks filled the stone plaza, their robes carrying colors I had never seen.
sentences.cn: 远方的弟子们涌入石广场，他们的衣袍颜色是我从未见过的。

sentences.en: The air hummed with a hundred different words at once.
sentences.cn: 空气里同时响起百般不同的言语。

doctor:1.en: In the outer market square below the gate, a crowd had gathered around an old man. He called himself a *doctor* of words — one who could read a person's spirit the way a healer reads a wound. He looked at me once, said nothing, and turned away too quickly. Shen Wujiu gripped my sleeve without explanation.
doctor:1.cnHint: 在山门外的市集上，弟子遇见了一位以词语为诊治手段的____。
doctor:1.hook: The old man's ink-stained hand was trembling.
doctor:1.line: 'A true *doctor* of words heals what medicine cannot reach,' the old man said.

sentences.en: In the outer market square below the gate, a crowd had gathered around an old man.
sentences.cn: 大门下方的外市集里，一群人围着一位老者。

sentences.en: He called himself a *doctor* of words — one who could read a person's spirit the way a healer reads a wound.
He looked at me once, said nothing, and turned away too quickly.
sentences.cn: 他只看了我一眼，什么也没说，转身离去得太急了。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu gripped my sleeve without explanation.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎紧紧握住我的袖子，没有解释。

economy:1.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a small pouch of carved word-stones before we crossed the bridge into town. 'Practice *economy*,' he said, meaning I should spend each word-stone only when truly needed — a wasted word weakens the next. I counted seven stones and felt the weight of that limit in my palm. The market below glittered with things I had no words left to reach.
economy:1.cnHint: 师兄叮嘱弟子在使用词石时要注重____，不可随意挥霍。
economy:1.hook: At the bridge's center, one stone in my pouch cracked on its own.
economy:1.line: '*Economy* with your words now means power when it matters most,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a small pouch of carved word-stones before we crossed the bridge into town.
sentences.cn: 过桥进城前，沈无咎递给我一个装着刻字石的小袋。

sentences.en: 'Practice *economy*,' he said, meaning I should spend each word-stone only when truly needed — a wasted word weakens the next.
I counted seven stones and felt the weight of that limit in my palm.
sentences.cn: 我数了数，一共七块石头，那份限制的分量在我掌心沉甸甸的。

sentences.en: The market below glittered with things I had no words left to reach.
sentences.cn: 下方的市集闪烁着我已无言可及的东西。

global:1.en: The elder at the sect's outer pillar unrolled a map that covered the entire stone floor. Every floating mountain in the known world was marked on it. He spoke of a *global* shift in the spiritual winds — all peaks, near and far, were tilting by a fraction each night. Master Qingwu studied the map's edge for a long time without speaking.
global:1.cnHint: 宗门长老展示一幅地图，描述一场影响____范围的灵气异变。
global:1.hook: One mountain on the map's far edge had no name written beneath it.
global:1.line: 'A *global* shift like this has not been seen in three hundred years,' Master Qingwu said.

sentences.en: The elder at the sect's outer pillar unrolled a map that covered the entire stone floor.
sentences.cn: 宗派外柱的长者铺开一幅地图，覆满了整块石地。

sentences.en: Every floating mountain in the known world was marked on it.
sentences.cn: 已知世界里的每一座浮山都标在了上面。

sentences.en: He spoke of a *global* shift in the spiritual winds — all peaks, near and far, were tilting by a fraction each night.
Master Qingwu studied the map's edge for a long time without speaking.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊盯着地图的边缘看了很久，一言不发。

leader:1.en: When the outer disciples lined up at dawn, no one moved until the *leader* of our group arrived. That was Shen Wujiu — chosen not by rank but by the quiet way he always knew which word was needed. He walked to the front without hurry and placed one word-stone on the ground. The mist parted ahead of us like a door opening.
leader:1.cnHint: 清晨，弟子们等待队伍____的到来，才敢出发。
leader:1.hook: The stone Shen Wujiu placed had a crack running straight through its center.
leader:1.line: 'A *leader* carries the group's words when their own voices fail,' Shen Wujiu said.

sentences.en: When the outer disciples lined up at dawn, no one moved until the *leader* of our group arrived.
That was Shen Wujiu — chosen not by rank but by the quiet way he always knew which word was needed.
sentences.cn: 那是沈无咎——他不是因为身份被选中，而是因为他总能用那份沉默的方式知道什么时候该用哪个字。

sentences.en: He walked to the front without hurry and placed one word-stone on the ground.
sentences.cn: 他不急不躁地走到了前方，在地上放下一块字石。

sentences.en: The mist parted ahead of us like a door opening.
sentences.cn: 雾气在我们前方裂开，像门被打开了。

scientific:1.en: Xiaoxing spread her notes across the flat rock at the mountain's base. Her method for learning word-herbs was careful and *scientific* — she tested each formula three times, recorded the results, and kept only what held true in all three trials. I admired the neat rows of her writing. Somewhere above us, a bell rang once, sharp and unplanned.
scientific:1.cnHint: 师妹用____的方法记录和验证每一种词草的效果。
scientific:1.hook: Her last recorded result had been scratched out and left blank.
scientific:1.line: 'A *scientific* mind and a still heart — that is how we survive what comes,' said Xiaoxing.

sentences.en: Xiaoxing spread her notes across the flat rock at the mountain's base.
sentences.cn: 小杏把她的笔记铺在山脚的平石上。

sentences.en: Her method for learning word-herbs was careful and *scientific* — she tested each formula three times, recorded the results, and kept only what held true in all three trials.
I admired the neat rows of her writing.
sentences.cn: 我欣赏她笔迹整齐的一行行字。

sentences.en: Somewhere above us, a bell rang once, sharp and unplanned.
sentences.cn: 什么地方上方传来一声钟鸣，尖锐而突兀。

evidence:1.en: The stone path outside the Hall of Words was swept clean each morning. But today I found the *evidence* of something strange: three silver feathers arranged in a perfect circle, still warm, as if a spirit bird had landed and left a warning no one else had seen.
evidence:1.cnHint: 我在大殿外的石径上发现了某种异常的____，三根银羽排成圆形。
evidence:1.hook: By nightfall, the feathers had turned to ash.
evidence:1.line: 'These feathers are *evidence* that the sky is no longer safe.'

sentences.en: The stone path outside the Hall of Words was swept clean each morning.
sentences.cn: 文字殿外的石径每个早晨都被扫得干干净净。

sentences.en: But today I found the *evidence* of something strange: three silver feathers arranged in a perfect circle, still warm, as if a spirit bird had landed and left a warning no one else had seen.

prefer:1.en: Shen Wujiu offered me two study scrolls at the mountain gate. One held wind formulas, bright and quick. The other held root words, slow but deep. 'Most new disciples *prefer* the wind,' he said softly. I chose the roots. Above us, a cold gust bent the pine trees the wrong way.
prefer:1.cnHint: 师兄问我更____哪种修炼卷轴，我选了根字诀。
prefer:1.hook: The bent pines did not straighten again.
prefer:1.line: 'I *prefer* the words that grow slow and last long.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu offered me two study scrolls at the mountain gate.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在山门口递给我两卷研习的手卷。

sentences.en: One held wind formulas, bright and quick.
sentences.cn: 一卷装着风的公式，明快而迅疾。

sentences.en: The other held root words, slow but deep.
sentences.cn: 另一卷装着根字，缓慢却深邃。

sentences.en: 'Most new disciples *prefer* the wind,' he said softly.
I chose the roots.
sentences.cn: 我选了根字。

sentences.en: Above us, a cold gust bent the pine trees the wrong way.
sentences.cn: 我们上方，一阵冷风吹得松树弯向了不该去的方向。

interview:1.en: Master Qingwu stood at the outer cliff to *interview* each new disciple before the trial season. She asked only one question: what word had called us to the sect. I answered. Her brush paused above the record scroll. A single drop of ink fell and spread like a storm cloud.
interview:1.cnHint: 师尊在悬崖边____每位新入门弟子，只问一个问题。
interview:1.hook: The ink drop held the shape of a falling mountain.
interview:1.line: 'I *interview* every disciple here, but your answer is the first to silence me.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu stood at the outer cliff to *interview* each new disciple before the trial season.
She asked only one question: what word had called us to the sect.
sentences.cn: 她只问了一个问题：什么字召唤了我们来到这个宗派。

sentences.en: I answered.
sentences.cn: 我回答了。

sentences.en: Her brush paused above the record scroll.
sentences.cn: 她的笔在记录卷上停顿了。

sentences.en: A single drop of ink fell and spread like a storm cloud.
sentences.cn: 一滴墨水掉下来，像风暴云一样晕开。

middle:1.en: Xiaoxing led me along the high ridge path to the herb garden. In the *middle* of the path, where two stone lines crossed, the air tasted of copper and old rain. She knelt and pressed one hand to the ground. Her eyes went wide. She said nothing for a long moment.
middle:1.cnHint: 在石径____，我们感受到了一股奇异的气息，师妹沉默不语。
middle:1.hook: The crossed lines began to glow a faint and hungry red.
middle:1.line: 'Stand back — the *middle* of this crossing holds something restless.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing led me along the high ridge path to the herb garden.
sentences.cn: 小杏领我沿着高岭的小径走向草药园。

sentences.en: In the *middle* of the path, where two stone lines crossed, the air tasted of copper and old rain.
She knelt and pressed one hand to the ground.
sentences.cn: 她跪下身，一只手按在地上。

sentences.en: Her eyes went wide.
sentences.cn: 她的眼睛睁得很大。

sentences.en: She said nothing for a long moment.
sentences.cn: 她沉默了很久，什么都没说。

standard:1.en: The sect posted its *standard* list of entry words on a wooden board by the gate: ten common terms every disciple must know. I had memorised all ten before dawn. But Shen Wujiu read the board again and pointed to a faint eleventh line that had not been there yesterday.
standard:1.cnHint: 门口木板上张贴了入门的____词表，但今天多出了神秘的第十一行。
standard:1.hook: The eleventh word had no translation written beside it.
standard:1.line: 'The *standard* list changed overnight — someone added a word no master taught us.'

sentences.en: The sect posted its *standard* list of entry words on a wooden board by the gate: ten common terms every disciple must know.
I had memorised all ten before dawn.
sentences.cn: 天亮之前我已经把这十个字全部背下来了。

sentences.en: But Shen Wujiu read the board again and pointed to a faint eleventh line that had not been there yesterday.
sentences.cn: 但沈无咎又看了一遍木板，指向一条淡淡的第十一行字，那是昨天没有的。

subject:1.en: At the outdoor lesson ledge, Master Qingwu announced the day's *subject*: the word for 'threshold,' which could open a sealed gate or close a wound. We sat in a half-circle above the clouds and repeated it softly. On the seventh repetition, the clouds below us parted in a long, clean line.
subject:1.cnHint: 师尊宣布了当日修习的____，我们随之诵读，云海随之裂开。
subject:1.hook: Through the parted clouds, something vast and dark stirred below.
subject:1.line: 'Today's *subject* is not a lesson — it is a test the mountain has set for you.'

sentences.en: At the outdoor lesson ledge, Master Qingwu announced the day's *subject*: the word for 'threshold,' which could open a sealed gate or close a wound.
We sat in a half-circle above the clouds and repeated it softly.
sentences.cn: 我们在云上半圆形地坐着，轻声重复那个字。

sentences.en: On the seventh repetition, the clouds below us parted in a long, clean line.
sentences.cn: 第七次重复时，我们下方的云在长长的一条线上整齐地裂开了。

accept:1.en: Xiaoxing brought me a small jade token after the morning drill — a gift from the senior disciples. I hesitated. Shen Wujiu watched from the pine shadow and gave a slow nod. I chose to *accept* it with both hands, as custom required. The token was ice-cold, though the sun was high and warm.
accept:1.cnHint: 师妹赠我玉令，我选择____这份礼物，却发现它冰凉异常。
accept:1.hook: A crack as thin as a hair ran across the token's face.
accept:1.line: '*Accept* it, but do not let it touch your heart meridian tonight.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing brought me a small jade token after the morning drill — a gift from the senior disciples.
sentences.cn: 早操后，小杏给我送来了一枚小玉牌——是师兄师姐们的礼物。

sentences.en: I hesitated.
sentences.cn: 我犹豫了。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu watched from the pine shadow and gave a slow nod.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在松影里看着，缓缓点了点头。

sentences.en: I chose to *accept* it with both hands, as custom required.
The token was ice-cold, though the sun was high and warm.
sentences.cn: 玉牌冰凉刺骨，可日头正高，阳光炽热。

act:1.en: A grey wind rose without warning along the outer terrace. Shen Wujiu shouted to *act* before the word-flags were swept away — those flags held the morning's practice formulas. I ran. I caught the last flag just as it left the pole. The wind stopped the instant my fingers closed.
act:1.cnHint: 突如其来的狂风袭来，师兄大喊要立刻____，我抓住了最后一面字旗。
act:1.hook: In my fist, the flag's word had changed to one I did not know.
act:1.line: '*Act* now — once those flags scatter, the formulas are lost for good.'

sentences.en: A grey wind rose without warning along the outer terrace.
sentences.cn: 一阵灰色的风突然沿着外平台卷起。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu shouted to *act* before the word-flags were swept away — those flags held the morning's practice formulas.
I ran.
sentences.cn: 我跑了。

sentences.en: I caught the last flag just as it left the pole.
sentences.cn: 我在最后一面旗飘离旗杆的瞬间抓住了它。

sentences.en: The wind stopped the instant my fingers closed.
sentences.cn: 我的手指一合，风就停了。

decline:1.en: The herb market on the outer terrace stretched along the mountain's eastern edge. Old traders muttered that word-sales had been in *decline* for three seasons — fewer disciples could afford rare syllables. I counted my copper coins twice. Beside me, Xiaoxing pressed her lips together and said nothing. Above us, a single cloud drifted upward, against the wind.
decline:1.cnHint: 外层露台的草药市场上，老商人们低声议论着买卖的____，小星默默站在一旁。
decline:1.hook: The cloud moved upward — clouds here never move upward.
decline:1.line: 'The *decline* in rare words worries me more than any storm,' said Xiaoxing softly.

sentences.en: The herb market on the outer terrace stretched along the mountain's eastern edge.
sentences.cn: 外平台的药市沿着山的东边铺开。

sentences.en: Old traders muttered that word-sales had been in *decline* for three seasons — fewer disciples could afford rare syllables.
I counted my copper coins twice.
sentences.cn: 我把铜板数了两遍。

sentences.en: Beside me, Xiaoxing pressed her lips together and said nothing.
sentences.cn: 小杏在我身边，抿着唇，什么也没说。

sentences.en: Above us, a single cloud drifted upward, against the wind.
sentences.cn: 我们上方，一朵白云逆风飘升。

extra:1.en: Shen Wujiu stopped at the word-stall near the sect's south gate and laid out two silver coins for a common healing syllable. The vendor slid one coin back and tucked an *extra* petal-scroll beside the purchase without a word. Shen Wujiu raised an eyebrow. I watched the vendor's hands — they were trembling slightly.
extra:1.cnHint: 沈无咎在南门药摊买字时，摊主悄悄多塞给他一卷____的花瓣卷轴，双手微微发抖。
extra:1.hook: No vendor gives extra scrolls without a reason — and the reason is never good.
extra:1.line: 'There is an *extra* scroll here,' Shen Wujiu said, his voice careful and low.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu stopped at the word-stall near the sect's south gate and laid out two silver coins for a common healing syllable.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在宗门南门的字摊前停下，铺出两枚银币买了一个常见的疗愈字。

sentences.en: The vendor slid one coin back and tucked an *extra* petal-scroll beside the purchase without a word.
Shen Wujiu raised an eyebrow.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎扬了扬眉。

sentences.en: I watched the vendor's hands — they were trembling slightly.
sentences.cn: 我看着摊主的手——微微颤抖着。

income:1.en: The outer disciples gathered each morning at the cloud-bridge bazaar to trade copied word-strips for coin. It was the only *income* most of us had before earning our first sect allowance. I sold three strips of 'breath' and bought one strip of 'rise.' Master Qingwu passed without stopping, yet her gaze lingered on my hands one moment too long.
income:1.cnHint: 外门弟子靠在云桥集市卖字条为生，这是我们唯一的____，师尊路过时多看了我的手一眼。
income:1.hook: Master Qingwu never lingers — unless she has already seen what is coming.
income:1.line: 'Your *income* from word-strips tells me how hard you study,' Master Qingwu said.

sentences.en: The outer disciples gathered each morning at the cloud-bridge bazaar to trade copied word-strips for coin.
sentences.cn: 外门弟子每天早上都在云桥市集里用抄好的字条换铜板。

sentences.en: It was the only *income* most of us had before earning our first sect allowance.
I sold three strips of 'breath' and bought one strip of 'rise.'
sentences.cn: 我卖了三张"息"的字条，买了一张"升"的。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu passed without stopping, yet her gaze lingered on my hands one moment too long.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊经过时没有停留，但她的目光在我的手上多停了一瞬。

medicine:1.en: At the terrace of a thousand pots, each clay jar held a living word used as *medicine* — 'cool' for a fever, 'still' for a shaking limb. I needed the word 'clear' for Xiaoxing's clouded sight, but the jar was sealed with red string. The herbalist shook his head slowly. Behind him, all the sealed jars had begun to hum.
medicine:1.cnHint: 千盆台上，每个陶罐里都盛着可作____的活字，但小星需要的那个字罐却被红绳封住了。
medicine:1.hook: Sealed jars do not hum — not unless the word inside is trying to escape.
medicine:1.line: 'That word is powerful *medicine*,' the herbalist warned, 'and it chooses its own healer.'

sentences.en: At the terrace of a thousand pots, each clay jar held a living word used as *medicine* — 'cool' for a fever, 'still' for a shaking limb.
I needed the word 'clear' for Xiaoxing's clouded sight, but the jar was sealed with red string.
sentences.cn: 我需要"清"这个字给小杏治眼花，可装它的罐子用红绳封着。

sentences.en: The herbalist shook his head slowly.
sentences.cn: 草药师缓缓摇头。

sentences.en: Behind him, all the sealed jars had begun to hum.
sentences.cn: 他身后，所有封着的罐子开始嗡嗡作响。

private:1.en: Behind the word-market stood a narrow passage the traders called the silent lane. Shen Wujiu led me there for a *private* lesson — he pressed a syllable of 'light' into my palm and made me hold it without speaking. The syllable warmed, then cooled, then warmed again. At the end of the lane, a door I had never noticed before stood half open.
private:1.cnHint: 沈无咎带我去集市后的小巷进行____的修炼课，他将一个"光"字压入我的掌心，那扇从未见过的门半开着。
private:1.hook: Doors that were not there yesterday do not open on their own.
private:1.line: 'This is a *private* lesson,' Shen Wujiu said. 'Tell no one what you feel in your hand.'

sentences.en: Behind the word-market stood a narrow passage the traders called the silent lane.
sentences.cn: 字市的后面有条窄巷，摊贩们叫它无声巷。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu led me there for a *private* lesson — he pressed a syllable of 'light' into my palm and made me hold it without speaking.
The syllable warmed, then cooled, then warmed again.
sentences.cn: 字开始发热，又冷了下来，再热起来。

sentences.en: At the end of the lane, a door I had never noticed before stood half open.
sentences.cn: 巷子尽头，有扇我从没见过的门，半开着。

side:1.en: The word-stalls lined both *sides* of the cloud-bridge, each banner painted with a single character glowing faintly gold. I walked the left side twice before I found what I needed: a small strip of 'hold,' pressed flat under a stone weight. As I reached for it, every banner on both sides flickered at once and went dark for one breath.
side:1.cnHint: 云桥两____摆满了字摊，我在左侧找到了需要的"握"字条，伸手去拿时所有招牌同时熄灭了一瞬。
side:1.hook: When every light blinks together, something above them has shifted its gaze.
side:1.line: 'Stand to my *side*,' said Shen Wujiu quietly, 'and do not reach for that strip again.'

sentences.en: The word-stalls lined both *sides* of the cloud-bridge, each banner painted with a single character glowing faintly gold.
I walked the left side twice before I found what I needed: a small strip of 'hold,' pressed flat under a stone weight.
sentences.cn: 我在左边走了两遍，才找到我要的东西：一张压扁的"持"字，用石头压在下面。

sentences.en: As I reached for it, every banner on both sides flickered at once and went dark for one breath.
sentences.cn: 我刚要伸手，两边的旗帜一齐闪灭，在一瞬间全暗了。

air:1.en: Just before the evening bell, the *air* above the outer bazaar changed — it thinned, the way it does before a high-mountain storm, and carried a faint taste of burned ink. Traders began rolling their word-strips without being told. Xiaoxing caught my sleeve and pointed upward. The sea of clouds far below had stopped moving entirely.
air:1.cnHint: 傍晚钟声前，集市上方的____突然稀薄下来，带着淡淡的焦墨气息，云海也停止了流动。
air:1.hook: A still cloud-sea means the sky above it is holding its breath.
air:1.line: 'The *air* has changed,' Xiaoxing whispered. 'Something large is passing over us.'

sentences.en: Just before the evening bell, the *air* above the outer bazaar changed — it thinned, the way it does before a high-mountain storm, and carried a faint taste of burned ink.
Traders began rolling their word-strips without being told.
sentences.cn: 摊主们没人吩咐就开始卷起字条。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing caught my sleeve and pointed upward.
sentences.cn: 小杏拉住我的袖子指向天空。

sentences.en: The sea of clouds far below had stopped moving entirely.
sentences.cn: 远下方的云海停住了，一动不动。

consumption:1.en: Master Qingwu had warned us: reckless use of power words led to swift *consumption* of one's inner energy, like burning a candle from both ends. At the bazaar I watched a senior disciple speak three flight-words in a row to show off. He landed pale and shaking on the stone steps. Nobody clapped. A thin crack spread across the step where he stood.
consumption:1.cnHint: 师尊曾告诫我们滥用力量字会导致内力的快速____，一位师兄当众连用三个飞行字后，面色惨白地跌落在石阶上。
consumption:1.hook: The crack in the stone was still spreading — and it had no reason to stop.
consumption:1.line: 'The *consumption* of three flight-words at once,' Master Qingwu said, 'is how disciples fall.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu had warned us: reckless use of power words led to swift *consumption* of one's inner energy, like burning a candle from both ends.
At the bazaar I watched a senior disciple speak three flight-words in a row to show off.
sentences.cn: 在市集里，我看到一个师兄连说三个飞行字来显摆。

sentences.en: He landed pale and shaking on the stone steps.
sentences.cn: 他苍白着脸、浑身发抖地落在石阶上。

sentences.en: Nobody clapped.
sentences.cn: 没人鼓掌。

sentences.en: A thin crack spread across the step where he stood.
sentences.cn: 他站着的地方，石阶上裂开了一条细缝。

field:1.en: Beyond the outer gate lay the training *field*, a wide stone platform suspended between two peaks. Disciples gathered there each dawn to speak their practice words aloud, letting the sounds rise like smoke. I found a quiet corner and shaped the word for wind. The clouds below the platform stirred — though the air above was still.
field:1.cnHint: 弟子们在悬空的练功____上晨练，我轻声念出风字，脚下云海却无风自动。
field:1.hook: Below the field, something vast moved through the clouds.
field:1.line: 'Meet me at the *field* before the morning bell — there is a word I must show you.'

sentences.en: Beyond the outer gate lay the training *field*, a wide stone platform suspended between two peaks.
Disciples gathered there each dawn to speak their practice words aloud, letting the sounds rise like smoke.
sentences.cn: 弟子们每天清晨都聚在那儿，大声说出练习的字，让声音像烟一样升起。

sentences.en: I found a quiet corner and shaped the word for wind.
sentences.cn: 我找了个安静的角落，塑造了风的字。

sentences.en: The clouds below the platform stirred — though the air above was still.
sentences.cn: 平台下方的云动了——可上面的空气纹丝不动。

personality:1.en: Shen Wujiu had a *personality* as sharp as a winter ridge — direct, a little proud, slow to smile. Yet when Xiaoxing stumbled over a healing word, he knelt without comment and traced the correct stroke in the stone dust for her to copy. I watched and understood: his sharpness was a shell, not a wall. That evening, the sect bell rang once, then fell silent mid-toll.
personality:1.cnHint: 师兄的____看似冷峻，却悄悄帮师妹纠正了字法，当晚钟声突然哑了。
personality:1.hook: The bell had not stopped on its own in living memory.
personality:1.line: 'His *personality* seems cold, but watch his hands — they are always helping.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu had a *personality* as sharp as a winter ridge — direct, a little proud, slow to smile.
Yet when Xiaoxing stumbled over a healing word, he knelt without comment and traced the correct stroke in the stone dust for her to copy.
sentences.cn: 可小杏绊到一个疗愈字时，他二话不说跪了下来，用手指在尘埃里描出正确的笔画让她临摹。

sentences.en: I watched and understood: his sharpness was a shell, not a wall.
sentences.cn: 我看着，明白了：他的尖锐是壳，不是墙。

sentences.en: That evening, the sect bell rang once, then fell silent mid-toll.
sentences.cn: 那天晚上，宗门的钟敲了一声，就在半途卡住了。

size:1.en: Master Qingwu unrolled a cloud-silk map of the outer peaks. The *size* of the dark region on its eastern edge had grown since last season — I could see the old ink line faint beneath the new one. 'The silent storm,' she said softly, 'does not announce itself.' She rolled the map closed before I could count the peaks it now covered.
size:1.cnHint: 师尊展开地图，东边暗域的____已比上季大了许多，她不等我细看便收了图。
size:1.hook: The new ink line was still wet.
size:1.line: 'Look at the *size* of that shadow — it was not there when I drew this map.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu unrolled a cloud-silk map of the outer peaks.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊展开了一幅云丝绘成的外峰地图。

sentences.en: The *size* of the dark region on its eastern edge had grown since last season — I could see the old ink line faint beneath the new one.
'The silent storm,' she said softly, 'does not announce itself.'
sentences.cn: "无声的风暴，"她轻声说，"不会预先宣告自己。"

sentences.en: She rolled the map closed before I could count the peaks it now covered.
sentences.cn: 她卷起地图，不让我数清上面现在覆盖了多少座山峰。

schedule:1.en: Each disciple received a clay tablet carved with a weekly *schedule*: dawn words, noon silence, dusk practice, and one hour of free study. Mine had an extra line at the bottom, added in a different hand — a time I did not recognise, a location left blank. I showed it to Xiaoxing; she had no such line on hers. Above us, a lone crane circled the peak three times and did not land.
schedule:1.cnHint: 我的功课____底部多了一行陌生的字迹，师妹的没有，一只鹤在山顶绕了三圈。
schedule:1.hook: No one admitted to writing that extra line.
schedule:1.line: 'Check your *schedule* again — something has been added that was not there this morning.'

sentences.en: Each disciple received a clay tablet carved with a weekly *schedule*: dawn words, noon silence, dusk practice, and one hour of free study.
Mine had an extra line at the bottom, added in a different hand — a time I did not recognise, a location left blank.
sentences.cn: 我的那块石板下方多了一行字，笔迹不同——一个我没见过的时间，地点空白。

sentences.en: I showed it to Xiaoxing; she had no such line on hers.
sentences.cn: 我拿给小杏看；她的石板上没有这样的一行。

sentences.en: Above us, a lone crane circled the peak three times and did not land.
sentences.cn: 我们上方，一只孤鹤绕着山峰转了三圈，最后没有降落。

towards:1.en: I walked *towards* the eastern archive at dusk, following the path of pale stones that caught the last light. The archive door stood open, which it never did after the fifth bell. A single candle burned on the reading stand, and beside it lay a scroll I had not placed there. Footprints in the dust led in — none led out.
towards:1.cnHint: 我朝东侧藏书阁走去，门竟敞着，烛台旁有一卷陌生的卷轴，地上只有进去的脚印。
towards:1.hook: The candle flame bent sideways, towards the sealed inner door.
towards:1.line: 'Do not walk *towards* that light until we know who lit it.'

sentences.en: I walked *towards* the eastern archive at dusk, following the path of pale stones that caught the last light.
The archive door stood open, which it never did after the fifth bell.
sentences.cn: 档案室的门敞开着，这在五更钟之后从未发生过。

sentences.en: A single candle burned on the reading stand, and beside it lay a scroll I had not placed there.
sentences.cn: 读书架上燃着一根蜡烛，旁边放着一卷我没有放过的书简。

sentences.en: Footprints in the dust led in — none led out.
sentences.cn: 尘埃中有脚印进来了——却没有脚印出去。

background:1.en: Shen Wujiu stood before the word-stone wall, his figure small against its *background* of carved formulas that stretched up into cloud. He was testing each word with one finger, listening for the tone the stone gave back. 'Every formula has a root,' he said without turning. 'Find the root and the rest reads itself.' Behind him, one carved word began to glow faint red — the word for danger.
background:1.cnHint: 师兄以刻满字诀的石壁为____独自试音，身后一个字忽然泛起红光。
background:1.hook: Red was not a colour those stones had ever shown before.
background:1.line: 'A word means nothing without its *background* — the stone it grows from matters as much as the stroke.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu stood before the word-stone wall, his figure small against its *background* of carved formulas that stretched up into cloud.
He was testing each word with one finger, listening for the tone the stone gave back.
sentences.cn: 他用一根手指试着触碰每个字，听石头反给他的音调。

sentences.en: 'Every formula has a root,' he said without turning.
sentences.cn: "每个咒语都有根，"他头也不转地说。

sentences.en: 'Find the root and the rest reads itself.'
sentences.cn: "找到根，其余的就自己读出来了。"

sentences.en: Behind him, one carved word began to glow faint red — the word for danger.
sentences.cn: 在他身后，一个雕刻的字开始泛起淡淡的红光——危险的字。

detail:1.en: Master Qingwu returned my practice scroll with one small mark near the third line. 'This *detail*,' she said, pressing her finger to a single brushstroke that leaned half a degree too far left, 'is the difference between a word that calms and a word that cuts.' I corrected it and felt the scroll grow warm in my hands. When I looked up, the sky to the north had turned a colour I had no word for yet.
detail:1.cnHint: 师尊指出我练字中一个微小的____，我改正后纸卷发热，北方天色随即变成了无法描述的颜色。
detail:1.hook: The colour spread slowly, and it was spreading towards us.
detail:1.line: 'Pay attention to every *detail* — a single crooked stroke can change a blessing into a wound.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu returned my practice scroll with one small mark near the third line.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊退回我的练习卷，在第三行附近留了一个小记号。

sentences.en: 'This *detail*,' she said, pressing her finger to a single brushstroke that leaned half a degree too far left, 'is the difference between a word that calms and a word that cuts.'
I corrected it and felt the scroll grow warm in my hands.
sentences.cn: 我改正了它，感觉卷子在我手里变得温热。

sentences.en: When I looked up, the sky to the north had turned a colour I had no word for yet.
sentences.cn: 我抬头看时，北边的天空已经变成了一种我还没有词汇来形容的颜色。

attack:1.en: On the outer terrace of Cloud Sea Sect, Shen Wujiu raised his hand without warning. A burst of wind qi flew from his palm and struck the practice post beside me. 'That,' he said quietly, 'is how a sudden *attack* should feel — fast, clean, no signal before the blow.'
attack:1.cnHint: 师兄在露台上演示了一次突然的____，让我明白何为先机。
attack:1.hook: The post cracked — but his eyes were watching me.
attack:1.line: 'An *attack* lands hardest when the other person expects nothing.'

sentences.en: On the outer terrace of Cloud Sea Sect, Shen Wujiu raised his hand without warning.
sentences.cn: 在云海宗的外露台上，沈无咎突然抬起了手。

sentences.en: A burst of wind qi flew from his palm and struck the practice post beside me.
sentences.cn: 一股风气从他掌心迸发，击中了我身旁的练习桩。

sentences.en: 'That,' he said quietly, 'is how a sudden *attack* should feel — fast, clean, no signal before the blow.'

heavy:1.en: Master Qingwu led us to the Stone Archive at the mountain's base. She placed a single jade scroll in my arms, and I nearly fell. 'The words inside are *heavy*,' she said, 'because they carry the full weight of every generation that wrote them.'
heavy:1.cnHint: 师尊将一卷古简交给我，那____让我险些站立不稳。
heavy:1.hook: A sound like distant thunder rose from within the scroll.
heavy:1.line: 'When knowledge is *heavy*, your footing must be steady.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu led us to the Stone Archive at the mountain's base.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊带我们来到了山脚的石经阁。

sentences.en: She placed a single jade scroll in my arms, and I nearly fell.
sentences.cn: 她把一卷玉简放进我的怀里，我差点摔倒。

sentences.en: 'The words inside are *heavy*,' she said, 'because they carry the full weight of every generation that wrote them.'

thought:1.en: I sat alone on the cloud-bridge between the two peaks, watching mist curl below my feet. One *thought* kept returning: why had Master Qingwu chosen me, the one who arrived late, the one whose herb-name was barely a whisper? The mist gave no answer.
thought:1.cnHint: 我独坐云桥，一个挥之不去的____让我无法平静。
thought:1.hook: Then a single feather, black as ink, drifted up from the sea of clouds.
thought:1.line: 'A *thought* that keeps returning is trying to teach you something.'

sentences.en: I sat alone on the cloud-bridge between the two peaks, watching mist curl below my feet.
sentences.cn: 我独自坐在两座山峰间的云桥上，看着雾气在脚下卷动。

sentences.en: One *thought* kept returning: why had Master Qingwu chosen me, the one who arrived late, the one whose herb-name was barely a whisper?
The mist gave no answer.
sentences.cn: 雾气没有给出答案。

attract:1.en: Xiaoxing discovered a cluster of silver grass near the east cliff path. 'Do not touch it,' Shen Wujiu warned. 'That herb is beautiful because it must *attract* wandering spirits to spread its seeds — and wherever those spirits gather, trouble follows.'
attract:1.cnHint: 小星在东崖小路上发现一丛奇草，师兄说它会____游荡的灵体。
attract:1.hook: Even as he spoke, the grass began to glow.
attract:1.line: 'The brightest things *attract* more than just the eyes.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing discovered a cluster of silver grass near the east cliff path.
sentences.cn: 小杏在东悬崖路附近发现了一簇银色的草。

sentences.en: 'Do not touch it,' Shen Wujiu warned.
sentences.cn: "不要碰它，"沈无咎警告道。

sentences.en: 'That herb is beautiful because it must *attract* wandering spirits to spread its seeds — and wherever those spirits gather, trouble follows.'

define:1.en: Master Qingwu drew a circle in the air with her finger, and a ring of pale light formed over the courtyard stones. 'A boundary does not only protect,' she said. 'It also serves to *define* you — what you stand for, what you refuse to let cross the line.'
define:1.cnHint: 师尊在庭院中画出一道光环，用它来____弟子的立场与本心。
define:1.hook: The circle held — but at its edge, something pressed quietly inward.
define:1.line: 'You must *define* your path before the path defines you.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu drew a circle in the air with her finger, and a ring of pale light formed over the courtyard stones.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊用手指在空中画了一个圆，一环苍白的光在院子的石板上形成。

sentences.en: 'A boundary does not only protect,' she said.
sentences.cn: "边界不只是保护，"她说。

sentences.en: 'It also serves to *define* you — what you stand for, what you refuse to let cross the line.'

executive:1.en: A messenger arrived from the inner hall bearing a sealed order. Shen Wujiu read it aloud: Senior Elder Yunhe had named a new *executive* disciple to oversee the herb distribution before the trial. The name on the paper was not his — it was mine. No one spoke.
executive:1.cnHint: 内堂来了一道命令，任命了一位负责草药分配的____弟子，那人竟是我。
executive:1.hook: Shen Wujiu folded the paper slowly and looked at the sky.
executive:1.line: 'An *executive* disciple carries the sect's word, not their own.'

sentences.en: A messenger arrived from the inner hall bearing a sealed order.
sentences.cn: 一位信使从内殿带来了一道盖好章的命令。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu read it aloud: Senior Elder Yunhe had named a new *executive* disciple to oversee the herb distribution before the trial.
The name on the paper was not his — it was mine.
sentences.cn: 纸上的名字不是他的——是我的。

sentences.en: No one spoke.
sentences.cn: 没有人说话。

expectation:1.en: We gathered on the open platform where new disciples receive their herb-names. Xiaoxing stood straight, hands clasped, trying not to show her nerves. 'Everyone comes here carrying *expectation*,' Shen Wujiu said softly beside me, 'like a jar filled to the brim — one wrong step and it spills.'
expectation:1.cnHint: 我们聚集在授名台上，师兄轻声说每个人都带着满满的____而来。
expectation:1.hook: Master Qingwu had not yet appeared, and the candle flames bent sideways.
expectation:1.line: '*Expectation* is a gift, but only if you do not let it blind you.'

sentences.en: We gathered on the open platform where new disciples receive their herb-names.
sentences.cn: 我们聚集在新弟子获得草名的开阔平台上。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing stood straight, hands clasped, trying not to show her nerves.
sentences.cn: 小杏笔直地站着，双手合十，试图不表现出紧张。

sentences.en: 'Everyone comes here carrying *expectation*,' Shen Wujiu said softly beside me, 'like a jar filled to the brim — one wrong step and it spills.'

friendly:1.en: Xiaoxing greeted the old gatekeeper every morning with a small bow and a bright smile. He was not required to respond, yet he always did. 'A *friendly* word costs nothing,' she told me as we walked the outer path together, 'but it plants a seed you may one day need.'
friendly:1.cnHint: 小星每天对守门老人送上____的问候，她说这是一粒迟早有用的种子。
friendly:1.hook: That evening, the gatekeeper left a single dried herb on our doorstep.
friendly:1.line: 'A *friendly* smile opens doors that strength cannot.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing greeted the old gatekeeper every morning with a small bow and a bright smile.
sentences.cn: 小杏每天早上都会给老门房深深鞠一躬，脸上带着灿烂的笑容。

sentences.en: He was not required to respond, yet he always did.
sentences.cn: 他本不必回应，可他总是回应的。

sentences.en: 'A *friendly* word costs nothing,' she told me as we walked the outer path together, 'but it plants a seed you may one day need.'

estimate:1.en: The stone path curved around the edge of the peak, where the morning mist had not yet lifted. Shen Wujiu stood beside me, studying the row of spirit-herb jars. 'My *estimate* is that we have enough night-bloom root for three cycles,' he said quietly. Above us, a single cloud moved against the wind.
estimate:1.cnHint: 师兄检查灵草储量，给出了他对药材是否够用的____，但头顶的云朵逆风而行。
estimate:1.hook: No cloud moves that way unless something stirs the sky.
estimate:1.line: 'My *estimate* is that we have enough night-bloom root for three cycles.'

sentences.en: The stone path curved around the edge of the peak, where the morning mist had not yet lifted.
sentences.cn: 石径在峰顶边缘蜿蜒而下，晨雾还未散开。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu stood beside me, studying the row of spirit-herb jars.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎站在我身边，凝视着那排灵草罐。

sentences.en: 'My *estimate* is that we have enough night-bloom root for three cycles,' he said quietly.
Above us, a single cloud moved against the wind.
sentences.cn: 我们上方，一朵单独的云彩逆风而行。

explore:1.en: Master Qingwu led us along the outer ridge of Cloud Peak before dawn. The path ended at a crack in the mountain face, deep and dark. 'Young disciples must *explore* what the sect has not yet mapped,' she said, her robe still as carved stone. The crack breathed cold air in slow, steady pulses.
explore:1.cnHint: 师尊带领弟子们来到山壁裂缝前，要求他们去____那片尚未绘入图册的区域。
explore:1.hook: The cold breath from the crack carried the scent of something ancient.
explore:1.line: 'Young disciples must *explore* what the sect has not yet mapped.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu led us along the outer ridge of Cloud Peak before dawn.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在黎明前沿着云峰的外脊带领我们前进。

sentences.en: The path ended at a crack in the mountain face, deep and dark.
sentences.cn: 小径在山崖的一道裂缝前断了，裂缝深邃漆黑。

sentences.en: 'Young disciples must *explore* what the sect has not yet mapped,' she said, her robe still as carved stone.
The crack breathed cold air in slow, steady pulses.
sentences.cn: 那道裂缝缓缓吐出冷气，节奏平稳而悠长。

fix:1.en: Xiaoxing and I stood at the high arch bridge between Twin Cloud Peaks. She pressed a carved word-stone into the iron rail, trying to *fix* it in place before the morning lesson began. The stone glowed faintly, then went cold. Across the bridge, a door we had never noticed swung open on its own.
fix:1.cnHint: 师妹试图将刻字灵石____在桥栏上，但灵石的光芒突然熄灭了。
fix:1.hook: A door that opens by itself is never an invitation.
fix:1.line: 'I need to *fix* this word-stone before Master Qingwu arrives.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing and I stood at the high arch bridge between Twin Cloud Peaks.
sentences.cn: 小杏和我站在双云峰之间的高拱桥上。

sentences.en: She pressed a carved word-stone into the iron rail, trying to *fix* it in place before the morning lesson began.
The stone glowed faintly, then went cold.
sentences.cn: 那块石头微弱地闪耀，随后冷却了。

sentences.en: Across the bridge, a door we had never noticed swung open on its own.
sentences.cn: 桥的另一头，一扇我们从未见过的门自动打开了。

general:1.en: The outer courtyard hummed with new disciples comparing notes. The *general* rule was simple: speak a word with full breath and clear thought, and the herb would respond. Most students struggled. I held a dried sky-mint leaf and whispered the word for 'rise.' The leaf lifted — then the whole bundle followed.
general:1.cnHint: 外院的____规则是用清晰的心念说出词语，灵草就会回应，但发生的事情超出了所有人的预料。
general:1.hook: The whole bundle rising was not part of any rule.
general:1.line: 'The *general* rule is clear breath, clear mind — nothing more.'

sentences.en: The outer courtyard hummed with new disciples comparing notes.
sentences.cn: 外院里嗡嗡声不断，新弟子们在互相讨论笔记。

sentences.en: The *general* rule was simple: speak a word with full breath and clear thought, and the herb would respond.
Most students struggled.
sentences.cn: 大多数学生都在挣扎。

sentences.en: I held a dried sky-mint leaf and whispered the word for 'rise.'
sentences.cn: 我拿着一片干燥的云薄荷叶，低声吟诵"升起"这个字。

sentences.en: The leaf lifted — then the whole bundle followed.
sentences.cn: 树叶飘起——整捆叶子都跟着浮了起来。

loss:1.en: Shen Wujiu sat alone on the steps of the herb pavilion, turning an empty jar in his hands. He had gathered those cloud-moss seeds for a full season. '*Loss* is also a teacher,' Master Qingwu said, passing without stopping. He set the jar down carefully. Far below, the sea of clouds swallowed the last of the evening light.
loss:1.cnHint: 师兄因珍贵药草的____而独自坐在台阶上，师尊只留下一句话便离去了。
loss:1.hook: The clouds below rose faster than any evening should allow.
loss:1.line: '*Loss* is also a teacher — do not waste the lesson.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu sat alone on the steps of the herb pavilion, turning an empty jar in his hands.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎独自坐在灵草阁的台阶上，在手中转动着一个空罐子。

sentences.en: He had gathered those cloud-moss seeds for a full season. '*Loss* is also a teacher,' Master Qingwu said, passing without stopping.
He set the jar down carefully.
sentences.cn: 他小心地放下罐子。

sentences.en: Far below, the sea of clouds swallowed the last of the evening light.
sentences.cn: 远下方，云海吞没了最后的晚光。

partner:1.en: Each new disciple was assigned a practice *partner* to share word-formulas and correct each other's breathing. Xiaoxing was mine. We stood back to back on the outer platform, reciting the word for 'steady' into the open wind. Our voices matched on the third try. The platform stone lit up beneath our feet.
partner:1.cnHint: 每位新弟子都被分配了一个练习____，两人需要合力诵出共鸣词语。
partner:1.hook: Stone does not light up unless two souls are in perfect accord.
partner:1.line: 'A good *partner* makes the word stronger than either voice alone.'

sentences.en: Each new disciple was assigned a practice *partner* to share word-formulas and correct each other's breathing.
Xiaoxing was mine.
sentences.cn: 小杏是我的。

sentences.en: We stood back to back on the outer platform, reciting the word for 'steady' into the open wind.
sentences.cn: 我们背靠背站在外平台上，向着开阔的风朗诵"稳定"这个字。

sentences.en: Our voices matched on the third try.
sentences.cn: 我们的声音在第三次尝试时合上了。

sentences.en: The platform stone lit up beneath our feet.
sentences.cn: 平台下的石头在我们脚下亮了起来。

concept:1.en: Master Qingwu drew a single character in the air above the morning square. It hung there, faintly golden. 'The *concept* behind this word is not power — it is patience,' she said. Around me, older disciples nodded slowly. I did not fully understand, but the character seemed to breathe. By noon it had vanished, leaving a faint warmth on my palm.
concept:1.cnHint: 师尊在晨间广场讲解一个词语背后的____，那个悬浮的字竟似乎在呼吸。
concept:1.hook: A word that breathes on its own has not finished speaking.
concept:1.line: 'The *concept* behind this word is not power — it is patience.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu drew a single character in the air above the morning square.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在晨间广场上方的空气中画了一个字。

sentences.en: It hung there, faintly golden.
sentences.cn: 它悬浮在那里，泛着淡淡的金光。

sentences.en: 'The *concept* behind this word is not power — it is patience,' she said.
Around me, older disciples nodded slowly.
sentences.cn: 我身边的老弟子们缓缓点头。

sentences.en: I did not fully understand, but the character seemed to breathe.
sentences.cn: 我还不完全理解，但那个字似乎在呼吸。

sentences.en: By noon it had vanished, leaving a faint warmth on my palm.
sentences.cn: 到了中午，它消散了，在我的掌心留下温暖的余韵。

history:1.en: The old archive hall stood at the far end of the sect grounds, its walls dark with age. Shen Wujiu unrolled a worn scroll and read aloud: the *history* of the Cloud Sea Sect began not with a master, but with a single forgotten word. Outside, the wind rose sharply. A shelf of sealed jars rattled once and fell still.
history:1.cnHint: 师兄在藏档厅中诵读宗门的____，得知宗门起源于一个被遗忘的词语。
history:1.hook: Forgotten words have a way of waking when their story is told.
history:1.line: 'The *history* of our sect begins with a word no one now remembers.'

sentences.en: The old archive hall stood at the far end of the sect grounds, its walls dark with age.
sentences.cn: 古老的档案厅耸立在宗门地界的远端，墙壁因岁月而暗沉。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu unrolled a worn scroll and read aloud: the *history* of the Cloud Sea Sect began not with a master, but with a single forgotten word.
Outside, the wind rose sharply.
sentences.cn: 外面，风势突然猛烈。

sentences.en: A shelf of sealed jars rattled once and fell still.
sentences.cn: 一架密封的罐子咔嚓晃动一下，随后归于寂静。

indeed:1.en: The trial stone at the sect gate glowed three colours when I pressed my palm against it. Master Qingwu stepped closer, studying the light. 'You have felt the pull of the sky-thunder,' she said softly. The stone *indeed* does not lie — my spiritual root was rarer than any record had named.
indeed:1.cnHint: 试灵石发出三色光芒，师尊说这块石头____不会说谎。
indeed:1.hook: Above the gate, one cloud turned suddenly, impossibly black.
indeed:1.line: 'This stone *indeed* shows what words alone cannot.'

sentences.en: The trial stone at the sect gate glowed three colours when I pressed my palm against it.
sentences.cn: 宗门山门处的试灵石在我按住掌心时闪耀出三种颜色。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu stepped closer, studying the light.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊靠近，研究着那束光。

sentences.en: 'You have felt the pull of the sky-thunder,' she said softly.
sentences.cn: "你感受到了天雷的牵引，"她轻声说。

sentences.en: The stone *indeed* does not lie — my spiritual root was rarer than any record had named.

launch:1.en: On the outer terrace, senior disciples lined up their spell-tablets along the stone rail. At Master Qingwu's signal they tilted each tablet forward, and with a sharp crack every one rose into the pale morning sky. The *launch* of the tablets marked the start of the sect's annual sky-survey, and the air smelled of cedar and ozone.
launch:1.cnHint: 外台上，师兄们将法牌整齐排开，随着师尊示意完成了一次____。
launch:1.hook: One tablet curved back, trembling, as if afraid to go higher.
launch:1.line: 'The *launch* must be clean — no tablet may waver.'

sentences.en: On the outer terrace, senior disciples lined up their spell-tablets along the stone rail.
sentences.cn: 在外平台上，高阶弟子们把他们的咒符平板沿着石栏排成一排。

sentences.en: At Master Qingwu's signal they tilted each tablet forward, and with a sharp crack every one rose into the pale morning sky.
sentences.cn: 在青梧师尊的信号下，他们将每块平板向前倾斜，尖锐的裂响声中，每一块都升上了苍白的晨空。

sentences.en: The *launch* of the tablets marked the start of the sect's annual sky-survey, and the air smelled of cedar and ozone.

refer:1.en: Shen Wujiu spread an old chart across the flat rock by the mountain path. He traced a line with one finger and looked up at me. 'When the sky darkens before a thunder-trial, we *refer* to this map — it shows every safe hollow on the peak where a disciple may shelter without breaking the trial's law.'
refer:1.cnHint: 师兄在山路旁展开古图，告诉我遇到危险时要____这张图找到避风处。
refer:1.hook: The map's ink, I noticed, had begun to move on its own.
refer:1.line: 'Always *refer* to the old chart before the thunder comes.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu spread an old chart across the flat rock by the mountain path.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在山路旁的平石上铺开一张古旧的图表。

sentences.en: He traced a line with one finger and looked up at me.
sentences.cn: 他用一根手指描过一条线，抬起眼看我。

sentences.en: 'When the sky darkens before a thunder-trial, we *refer* to this map — it shows every safe hollow on the peak where a disciple may shelter without breaking the trial's law.'

trust:1.en: Xiaoxing handed me a small jade vial on the path below the second gate. Her voice was steady. 'Drink it only if your breath fails during the trial.' I held the vial and felt the weight of her words more than its weight in my palm — a quiet *trust* she was placing in my hands without asking for anything back.
trust:1.cnHint: 师妹在二门下递给我一只玉瓶，这份____让我感到肩上多了一份责任。
trust:1.hook: A single petal fell upward, against all reason, into the grey sky.
trust:1.line: 'I place my *trust* in you — do not let the vial break.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing handed me a small jade vial on the path below the second gate.
sentences.cn: 小杏在第二道门下的小路上递给我一个玉色的小瓶子。

sentences.en: Her voice was steady.
sentences.cn: 她的声音很稳定。

sentences.en: 'Drink it only if your breath fails during the trial.'
sentences.cn: '只有在试炼中呼吸困难时才能喝。'

sentences.en: I held the vial and felt the weight of her words more than its weight in my palm — a quiet *trust* she was placing in my hands without asking for anything back.

discussion:1.en: Near the herb garden gate, three outer disciples stood in low voices around a cracked spirit-lantern. Their *discussion* grew quieter as I passed: they were debating whether the sky-thunder this season would strike the peak once or three times, and their faces, lit by the lantern's failing glow, did not look certain of either answer.
discussion:1.cnHint: 药圃门旁，几位外门弟子围着残灯，正进行一场关于天劫次数的____。
discussion:1.hook: The lantern went dark the moment the last word was spoken.
discussion:1.line: 'This *discussion* must end before the first bell rings.'

sentences.en: Near the herb garden gate, three outer disciples stood in low voices around a cracked spirit-lantern.
sentences.cn: 在草药园的门边，三个外门弟子用低沉的声音围在一盏裂开的灵灯前。

sentences.en: Their *discussion* grew quieter as I passed: they were debating whether the sky-thunder this season would strike the peak once or three times, and their faces, lit by the lantern's failing glow, did not look certain of either answer.

extremely:1.en: The wind along the cliff walk was *extremely* cold that morning, far colder than any autumn I had known before joining the sect. Shen Wujiu walked beside me without tying his outer robe, as though the chill meant nothing to him. I pulled my collar up and wondered how many sky-trials a person must survive before cold loses its bite.
extremely:1.cnHint: 悬崖小道上的风____寒冷，师兄却坦然若无其事地并肩而行。
extremely:1.hook: Then the wind stopped — total silence — for three full breaths.
extremely:1.line: 'It is *extremely* cold today; keep your spirit-fire lit inside.'

sentences.en: The wind along the cliff walk was *extremely* cold that morning, far colder than any autumn I had known before joining the sect.
Shen Wujiu walked beside me without tying his outer robe, as though the chill meant nothing to him.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎走在我身边，外衣都没系上，仿佛寒冷对他毫无影响。

sentences.en: I pulled my collar up and wondered how many sky-trials a person must survive before cold loses its bite.
sentences.cn: 我拉起衣领，想知道一个人得活过多少次天雷才能让寒冷失去牙齿。

organize:1.en: Master Qingwu stood at the crossroads of the three outer paths and asked Shen Wujiu to *organize* the younger disciples into two groups before the clouds closed in. He moved quickly, calling names, pointing left and right, his voice calm but carrying. Within moments the path was ordered, and the mountain felt less like chaos and more like a breath held steady.
organize:1.cnHint: 师尊站在三岔路口，命师兄____年轻弟子分成两队，以备天劫将至。
organize:1.hook: One disciple's name was called twice, but she was already gone.
organize:1.line: '*Organize* yourselves now — the sky will not wait for us.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu stood at the crossroads of the three outer paths and asked Shen Wujiu to *organize* the younger disciples into two groups before the clouds closed in.
He moved quickly, calling names, pointing left and right, his voice calm but carrying.
sentences.cn: 他动作很快，喊着名字，指向左右，声音平静但很有穿透力。

sentences.en: Within moments the path was ordered, and the mountain felt less like chaos and more like a breath held steady.
sentences.cn: 片刻间小路就被整顿好了，山峰感觉不再混乱，而像是屏住了一口气。

pattern:1.en: I knelt by the stone steps outside the archive hall, studying the cracks that years of lightning had burned into the rock. Xiaoxing crouched beside me and pointed: every strike had followed the same *pattern*, a spiral ending at a single dark point no larger than a thumb. 'The sky-thunder has memory,' she whispered, and I believed her.
pattern:1.cnHint: 档案堂外的石阶上，历年雷击留下了同一种____，师妹说天劫是有记忆的。
pattern:1.hook: Beneath my finger, the dark centre of the spiral felt warm.
pattern:1.line: 'Study this *pattern* — it will tell you where not to stand.'

sentences.en: I knelt by the stone steps outside the archive hall, studying the cracks that years of lightning had burned into the rock.
sentences.cn: 我跪在藏书殿外的石阶边，研究着岁月中闪电烧出的裂纹。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing crouched beside me and pointed: every strike had followed the same *pattern*, a spiral ending at a single dark point no larger than a thumb.
'The sky-thunder has memory,' she whispered, and I believed her.
sentences.cn: '天雷有记忆，'她低声说，我相信了她。

transform:1.en: The outer courtyard of the Cloud Sea Sect lay open beneath a pale sky. Master Qingwu placed a single word-seed in my palm and said nothing. I held it, and felt the stone path beneath my feet begin to *transform* — cracks filling with soft green light, cold tiles warming like skin. The mountain itself was breathing.
transform:1.cnHint: 师尊将一粒字种放入我掌心，石路开始____，裂缝中涌出柔绿的光。
transform:1.hook: Then the light reached the sect gate, and the gate groaned.
transform:1.line: 'Watch how one true word can *transform* even stone,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: The outer courtyard of the Cloud Sea Sect lay open beneath a pale sky.
sentences.cn: 云海宗的外庭在苍白的天空下敞开着。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu placed a single word-seed in my palm and said nothing.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在我掌心放了一粒字种，什么都没说。

sentences.en: I held it, and felt the stone path beneath my feet begin to *transform* — cracks filling with soft green light, cold tiles warming like skin.
The mountain itself was breathing.
sentences.cn: 山峰本身在呼吸。

additional:1.en: Shen Wujiu met me at the supply pavilion before dawn. He handed me my standard scroll-pack, then paused. 'One *additional* herb,' he said, pressing a silver sprig into my hand. 'Cloud-mint. It steadies the breath when a formula turns wild.' Outside, the morning fog thickened without reason.
additional:1.cnHint: 师兄在清晨给了我标准卷轴包，还额外给了一株____的云薄荷，说它能在咒式失控时稳住呼吸。
additional:1.hook: The fog did not thin — it rose, and took the shape of a hand.
additional:1.line: 'Take this *additional* herb — you may need it before nightfall,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu met me at the supply pavilion before dawn.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在天亮前在补给亭里等我。

sentences.en: He handed me my standard scroll-pack, then paused.
sentences.cn: 他递给我标准的卷轴包，然后停顿了一下。

sentences.en: 'One *additional* herb,' he said, pressing a silver sprig into my hand.
'Cloud-mint.
sentences.cn: '还有一味草药，'他说，把一根银色的嫩枝塞进我手里。

sentences.en: It steadies the breath when a formula turns wild.'
sentences.cn: 是云薄荷。

sentences.en: Outside, the morning fog thickened without reason.
sentences.cn: 当药方变得狂野时它能稳定呼吸。'外面晨雾无故浓了起来。

journal:1.en: Xiaoxing kept a small cloth *journal* in which she pressed every word-herb she collected, each page stained faintly with color — gold for healing, blue for flight. She showed it to me at the edge of the cloud-bridge, sunlight catching the pages. One entry near the back was smeared, as if something wet had fallen on it fast.
journal:1.cnHint: 师妹将采集到的每一株字草压入她的____中，每页都染着淡淡的色彩，但最后一页被什么打湿了。
journal:1.hook: She closed the journal before I could read that final entry.
journal:1.line: 'Every word I have ever gathered is in this *journal*,' said Xiaoxing softly.

sentences.en: Xiaoxing kept a small cloth *journal* in which she pressed every word-herb she collected, each page stained faintly with color — gold for healing, blue for flight.
She showed it to me at the edge of the cloud-bridge, sunlight catching the pages.
sentences.cn: 她在云桥边给我看它，阳光打在书页上。

sentences.en: One entry near the back was smeared, as if something wet had fallen on it fast.
sentences.cn: 后面有一条记录被弄脏了，仿佛什么湿漉漉的东西快速落在了上面。

sort:1.en: The morning market on the lower terrace was loud with disciples trading word-herbs. I did not know what *sort* of formula I was meant to build — healing, warding, or something older. I walked each row slowly, letting the herbs lean toward my hand as if choosing me. At the last stall, three black seeds rolled to the edge of their bowl on their own.
sort:1.cnHint: 在下层台地的早市上，我不知道自己该配制哪一____的咒式，直到三粒黑色种子自己滚到了碗沿。
sort:1.hook: The stall-keeper had already turned away, pretending not to see.
sort:1.line: 'What *sort* of formula do you intend to carry into tonight?' asked Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: The morning market on the lower terrace was loud with disciples trading word-herbs.
sentences.cn: 下平台的早市里，弟子们吵吵嚷嚷地交易着字草。

sentences.en: I did not know what *sort* of formula I was meant to build — healing, warding, or something older.
I walked each row slowly, letting the herbs lean toward my hand as if choosing me.
sentences.cn: 我慢慢地走过每一排，让草药向我的手倾斜，仿佛它们在选择我。

sentences.en: At the last stall, three black seeds rolled to the edge of their bowl on their own.
sentences.cn: 在最后一个摊位，三粒黑色的种子自己滚到了碗边。

understanding:1.en: Master Qingwu drew a long word-formula on the air above the stone courtyard, then let it dissolve. 'Copy it from memory,' she said. I tried twice and failed. On the third attempt I stopped trying to remember the shape and instead felt for its meaning. The formula bloomed steady and whole. *Understanding*, I saw, was the root — not the strokes.
understanding:1.cnHint: 师尊让我默写咒式，前两次都失败了，第三次我停止记形状，去感受它的含义，才明白____才是根本。
understanding:1.hook: Master Qingwu said nothing — she only looked at the sky.
understanding:1.line: 'Skill fades, but *understanding* stays with you,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: Master Qingwu drew a long word-formula on the air above the stone courtyard, then let it dissolve.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在石庭上空用长长的字诀在空中画出来，然后让它消散。

sentences.en: 'Copy it from memory,' she said.
sentences.cn: '从记忆里复制它，'她说。

sentences.en: I tried twice and failed.
sentences.cn: 我试了两次都失败了。

sentences.en: On the third attempt I stopped trying to remember the shape and instead felt for its meaning.
sentences.cn: 第三次我停止了试图去记住形状，而是去感受它的含义。

sentences.en: The formula bloomed steady and whole.
sentences.cn: 字诀绽放得稳定而完整。

sentences.en: *Understanding*, I saw, was the root — not the strokes.

citizen:1.en: A traveling elder passed through the sect gate, carrying sealed letters from the cloud-valley town below. He said every *citizen* of the valley had felt a tremor in the night — not of earth, but of meaning, as if a great word had broken somewhere above them. He left before anyone could ask more. The letters sat unopened on the steps.
citizen:1.cnHint: 一位云谷镇的长老带来消息，说镇上每一位____昨夜都感到了一阵震动，不是地震，而是某个巨大字义的碎裂。
citizen:1.hook: The letters on the steps began, slowly, to glow.
citizen:1.line: 'Every *citizen* of the valley felt the tremor last night,' the elder said.

sentences.en: A traveling elder passed through the sect gate, carrying sealed letters from the cloud-valley town below.
sentences.cn: 一位游历的长者穿过宗门的门楼，带着来自下方云谷小镇的密封信件。

sentences.en: He said every *citizen* of the valley had felt a tremor in the night — not of earth, but of meaning, as if a great word had broken somewhere above them.
He left before anyone could ask more.
sentences.cn: 他在任何人能问出更多之前就离开了。

sentences.en: The letters sat unopened on the steps.
sentences.cn: 那些信件静静地躺在台阶上。

contrast:1.en: Xiaoxing stood beside Shen Wujiu at the arch of the eastern path. Her word-robe glowed faint white; his was deep river-grey. The *contrast* between them seemed to say something I could not yet name — one of them had been preparing for tonight far longer than the other. A bell rang once from the upper peak, though no hand had touched it.
contrast:1.cnHint: 师妹白袍与师兄深灰袍的____之间，似乎隐藏着某种我还无法说清的秘密，正当此时，山顶的钟无人敲响却自鸣。
contrast:1.hook: Neither of them looked at the bell, and that was the strangest thing.
contrast:1.line: 'The *contrast* between these two herbs tells you which one to use,' said Shen Wujiu.

sentences.en: Xiaoxing stood beside Shen Wujiu at the arch of the eastern path.
sentences.cn: 小杏站在沈无咎身边，靠近东路的拱门。

sentences.en: Her word-robe glowed faint white; his was deep river-grey.
sentences.cn: 她的字衣闪着淡白的光；他的是深河灰。

sentences.en: The *contrast* between them seemed to say something I could not yet name — one of them had been preparing for tonight far longer than the other.
A bell rang once from the upper peak, though no hand had touched it.
sentences.cn: 上峰传来一声钟鸣，虽然没有人去敲。

establish:1.en: Before any disciple could attempt the trial path, they had to *establish* a root-word — one character spoken aloud, set into the stone like an anchor. I chose mine at noon, standing in the open square with the cloud-sea far below. The word left my mouth and sank into the ground. A thin crack ran from where I stood all the way to the sect wall.
establish:1.cnHint: 每位弟子必须在试炼前____一个根字，将其刻入石中作为锚点，而我的根字入地后，地面裂出了一道缝。
establish:1.hook: The crack stopped at the wall — then continued on the other side.
establish:1.line: 'You must *establish* your root-word before the sky changes,' said Master Qingwu.

sentences.en: Before any disciple could attempt the trial path, they had to *establish* a root-word — one character spoken aloud, set into the stone like an anchor.
I chose mine at noon, standing in the open square with the cloud-sea far below.
sentences.cn: 我在正午时选择了我的字，站在开阔的广场上，云海在下方远处。

sentences.en: The word left my mouth and sank into the ground.
sentences.cn: 那个字从我口中吐出，沉入了地下。

sentences.en: A thin crack ran from where I stood all the way to the sect wall.
sentences.cn: 一道细裂纹从我站立的地方一直延伸到宗门的墙边。

difficulty:2.en: The sealed chamber beneath the Herb Hall held a single scroll. I unrolled it with care and found the old characters packed tight, each one a *difficulty* I could not yet name. Shen Wujiu had warned me the text resisted every disciple who came before. Still, one phrase shone faintly, as if it had been waiting for me.
difficulty:2.cnHint: 我在药堂地下密室发现一卷古籍，每个字都是一道____，但有一句话似乎在等待着我。
difficulty:2.hook: The glowing phrase rearranged itself the moment I blinked.
difficulty:2.line: 'Each *difficulty* in that scroll is a gate, not a wall,' Shen Wujiu said.

sentences.en: The sealed chamber beneath the Herb Hall held a single scroll.
sentences.cn: 药堂下的密室里放着一卷古籍。

sentences.en: I unrolled it with care and found the old characters packed tight, each one a *difficulty* I could not yet name.
Shen Wujiu had warned me the text resisted every disciple who came before.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎曾警告过我，这文字挡住了之前来过的每一个弟子。

sentences.en: Still, one phrase shone faintly, as if it had been waiting for me.
sentences.cn: 可其中有一句话隐隐发光，仿佛一直在等我。

full:2.en: Xiaoxing set the jade bowl on the stone table. It was *full* to the very brim with a liquid the colour of early dawn, gathered, she said, from clouds that had never touched a mountain. I leaned close and saw my own reflection — but the face looking back wore an expression I did not recognise.
full:2.cnHint: 小星将一只盛得____的玉碗放在石桌上，我在碗中看见了自己，却认不出那个表情。
full:2.hook: The reflection in the bowl slowly turned its head away.
full:2.line: 'The bowl must be *full* before the night of the trial,' Xiaoxing said softly.

sentences.en: Xiaoxing set the jade bowl on the stone table.
sentences.cn: 小杏把玉碗放在了石桌上。

sentences.en: It was *full* to the very brim with a liquid the colour of early dawn, gathered, she said, from clouds that had never touched a mountain.
I leaned close and saw my own reflection — but the face looking back wore an expression I did not recognise.
sentences.cn: 我俯身看去，看到了自己的倒影——但那张脸露出了我不认识的表情。

range:2.en: Master Qingwu spread an old map across the cloud-stone floor. Her finger traced the *range* of peaks that circled our sect like a row of silent judges. Beyond the outermost summit, she said, lay a region where spoken words lost all power. No disciple had returned with a full report.
range:2.cnHint: 师尊展开地图，指出包围本门的山____，并说最外峰之外，文字将失去一切力量。
range:2.hook: One peak on the map had no name, only a brushstroke shaped like a closed eye.
range:2.line: 'The *range* of your voice must reach the farthest peak before dawn,' Master Qingwu said.

sentences.en: Master Qingwu spread an old map across the cloud-stone floor.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在云石地面上铺开了一张古地图。

sentences.en: Her finger traced the *range* of peaks that circled our sect like a row of silent judges.
Beyond the outermost summit, she said, lay a region where spoken words lost all power.
sentences.cn: 她说，最外层山峰的那一边，有个地方让说出的话失去了所有力量。

sentences.en: No disciple had returned with a full report.
sentences.cn: 没有哪个弟子带回过完整的报告。

region:2.en: The old logbook listed every *region* of the Cloud Sea that disciples had charted over three hundred years. Page after page, each area was marked safe or forbidden. I found one blank square near the eastern edge — no ink, no seal, as if the scribe's hand had stopped mid-breath and never returned to finish.
region:2.cnHint: 旧日志记录了三百年间弟子勘测的每片云海____，但东侧有一块空白，似乎书写者中途停笔，再未续写。
region:2.hook: Beneath the blank square, a single dried droplet stained the page dark red.
region:2.line: 'That *region* has not been named because no one came back to name it,' Shen Wujiu said quietly.

sentences.en: The old logbook listed every *region* of the Cloud Sea that disciples had charted over three hundred years.
Page after page, each area was marked safe or forbidden.
sentences.cn: 一页页翻过，每个区域都标注着安全或禁地。

sentences.en: I found one blank square near the eastern edge — no ink, no seal, as if the scribe's hand had stopped mid-breath and never returned to finish.
sentences.cn: 我在东边边缘找到了一个空白的方格——没有墨迹，没有印鉴，仿佛抄写者的手停在了中途，再也没有回来完成。

material:2.en: Shen Wujiu laid five objects on the bench: a feather, a river stone, a length of bark, a shard of cloud-ice, and a tooth from an unknown creature. 'Each one is *material* for a word-formula,' he said. I reached for the cloud-ice and felt a sharp cold climb straight to my shoulder, far deeper than I expected.
material:2.cnHint: 师兄将五件物品摆在案上，说每件都是炼制咒文的____，我取起云冰时感到一股寒意直透肩头。
material:2.hook: The feather began to tremble without any wind.
material:2.line: 'Choose your *material* carefully — the formula takes on its nature,' Shen Wujiu said.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu laid five objects on the bench: a feather, a river stone, a length of bark, a shard of cloud-ice, and a tooth from an unknown creature.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在长凳上放了五样东西：一根羽毛、一块河石、一段树皮、一片云冰，还有一颗不知来自何物的牙齿。

sentences.en: 'Each one is *material* for a word-formula,' he said.
I reached for the cloud-ice and felt a sharp cold climb straight to my shoulder, far deeper than I expected.
sentences.cn: 我伸手去拿云冰，感到一股锐利的寒冷直直爬上我的肩膀，远比我预料的要深。

pressure:2.en: I pressed my palm to the formation seal at the archive gate. The *pressure* that pushed back was not physical; it entered through the skin and tested something deeper, something I could only call intention. I held my breath. Then the gate accepted me, and a low hum filled the corridor like a held note finally released.
pressure:2.cnHint: 我将手掌贴上封印，感受到一股测试内心意志的____，屏息之后，门终于接纳了我。
pressure:2.hook: Behind the open gate, a single candle burned sideways, its flame pointing inward.
pressure:2.line: 'The *pressure* of the seal reads your will, not your strength,' Master Qingwu said.

sentences.en: I pressed my palm to the formation seal at the archive gate.
sentences.cn: 我把手掌按在档案库大门的阵法封印上。

sentences.en: The *pressure* that pushed back was not physical; it entered through the skin and tested something deeper, something I could only call intention.
I held my breath.
sentences.cn: 我屏住了呼吸。

sentences.en: Then the gate accepted me, and a low hum filled the corridor like a held note finally released.
sentences.cn: 然后大门接纳了我，一声低鸣充满了走廊，就像一个被长久按住的音符终于释放了出来。

thus:2.en: Xiaoxing had placed a small stone marker at every point where the morning cloud rose through the rock. Linked together, the markers formed a circle. She spoke the binding word, and *thus* the circle became a lens that gathered scattered spirit-light into one bright column. I watched the light and understood, for the first time, what a completed formula felt like.
thus:2.cnHint: 小星把石标连成圆阵，念出结印之词，____将散逸的灵光聚成一柱，我第一次真切感受到完整咒文的力量。
thus:2.hook: At the column's peak, a shape formed — and then dissolved before I could read it.
thus:2.line: 'Speak the root word first, and *thus* the rest will follow,' Xiaoxing said.

sentences.en: Xiaoxing had placed a small stone marker at every point where the morning cloud rose through the rock.
sentences.cn: 小杏在每个晨雾从岩石中升起的地点放了一个小石标。

sentences.en: Linked together, the markers formed a circle.
sentences.cn: 把这些标记连在一起，就成了一个圆。

sentences.en: She spoke the binding word, and *thus* the circle became a lens that gathered scattered spirit-light into one bright column.
I watched the light and understood, for the first time, what a completed formula felt like.
sentences.cn: 我看着那光芒，第一次理解了什么叫完成的咒语。

tool:2.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a narrow bone stylus worn smooth by many hands before mine. 'This is only a *tool*,' he said, 'but it remembers every word ever written with it.' I held it loosely as he showed me, and the moment it touched the practice stone, a faint hum rose, as if the stylus were finishing a sentence left unfinished long ago.
tool:2.cnHint: 师兄递给我一支被历代人磨光的骨笔，说它只是____，却记得曾经写下的每一个字。
tool:2.hook: The hum grew louder when I pointed the stylus toward the sealed eastern wall.
tool:2.line: 'A *tool* holds memory; the word holds power — know the difference,' Shen Wujiu said.

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a narrow bone stylus worn smooth by many hands before mine.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎递给我一根狭长的骨笔，笔身被许多在我之前的人磨得光滑。

sentences.en: 'This is only a *tool*,' he said, 'but it remembers every word ever written with it.'
I held it loosely as he showed me, and the moment it touched the practice stone, a faint hum rose, as if the stylus were finishing a sentence left unfinished long ago.
sentences.cn: 我按他示范的方式轻轻拿着，笔尖一触到练习石，一声微弱的鸣音就升起了，仿佛这根笔在完成一个很久以前就未完成的句子。

international:2.en: Shen Wujiu spread a worn scroll across the stone table. 'This formula,' he said quietly, 'was shared by sects from every distant peak — it is *international* in a way few words ever become.' I traced the characters with one finger, feeling their warmth pulse like a slow heartbeat. Outside, the clouds below our mountain turned a deep, warning amber.
international:2.cnHint: 师兄展示一份来自各方门派的卷轴，说明这个法诀具有____的影响力。
international:2.hook: The amber clouds had never risen this high before.
international:2.line: 'This formula is *international* — every great sect has added one word to it.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu spread a worn scroll across the stone table.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在石桌上铺开了一卷破旧的古籍。

sentences.en: 'This formula,' he said quietly, 'was shared by sects from every distant peak — it is *international* in a way few words ever become.'
I traced the characters with one finger, feeling their warmth pulse like a slow heartbeat.
sentences.cn: 我用一根手指描摹着那些字，感到它们的温度像缓慢的心跳一样脉动。

sentences.en: Outside, the clouds below our mountain turned a deep, warning amber.
sentences.cn: 外面，我们山下的云层转成了深沉的、警告般的琥珀色。

manage:2.en: The storage jar held seven spirit-herbs, each one a living word. Master Qingwu watched as I tried to *manage* them all at once, keeping each syllable from clashing with the next. My hands shook, but the herbs stayed calm. Then a single crack ran across the jar's lid, slow and deliberate as a signature.
manage:2.cnHint: 师尊看着我试图____七株灵草，让它们彼此不互相冲突。
manage:2.hook: The crack in the lid spelled out one word none of us knew.
manage:2.line: 'Can you *manage* all seven herbs without letting one fade?'

sentences.en: The storage jar held seven spirit-herbs, each one a living word.
sentences.cn: 这个储存罐里装着七株灵草，每一株都是活着的字。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu watched as I tried to *manage* them all at once, keeping each syllable from clashing with the next.
My hands shook, but the herbs stayed calm.
sentences.cn: 我的手有些颤抖，但那些灵草保持着平静。

sentences.en: Then a single crack ran across the jar's lid, slow and deliberate as a signature.
sentences.cn: 然后一道细小的裂纹在罐子的盖子上缓缓出现，缓慢而有意地，就像一个签名。

outside:2.en: Xiaoxing found the letter pressed under a flat cloud-stone near the gate. The seal was unfamiliar — pale green wax, no name. '*Outside* our mountain,' she read aloud, 'a new word waits for the one brave enough to descend.' I felt the ground beneath my feet hum, as though the mountain itself had heard.
outside:2.cnHint: 师妹在山门附近发现一封信，说在山的____有什么东西在等待。
outside:2.hook: The mountain's hum grew louder after each word she read.
outside:2.line: '*Outside* our gate, beyond the cloud line, something left this seal.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing found the letter pressed under a flat cloud-stone near the gate.
sentences.cn: 小杏在大门附近的一块平云石下找到了那封信。

sentences.en: The seal was unfamiliar — pale green wax, no name. '*Outside* our mountain,' she read aloud, 'a new word waits for the one brave enough to descend.'
I felt the ground beneath my feet hum, as though the mountain itself had heard.
sentences.cn: 我感到脚下的地面嗡鸣起来，仿佛这座山本身都听到了。

fun:2.en: Shen Wujiu called the evening drill pure *fun*, laughing as spirit-words chased each other around the courtyard like lit sparks. I caught three of them in my palm and felt something close to joy. But when the last spark went out, the courtyard stayed dark a breath too long, and the stars above looked fewer than before.
fun:2.cnHint: 师兄把傍晚的修炼说成是一种____，但练习结束后天空中的星星似乎少了几颗。
fun:2.hook: Stars, once counted every night, had quietly gone missing.
fun:2.line: 'Call it *fun* if you like — but your grip on those words is growing sharp.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu called the evening drill pure *fun*, laughing as spirit-words chased each other around the courtyard like lit sparks.
I caught three of them in my palm and felt something close to joy.
sentences.cn: 我在掌心捉住了三个，感受到了接近喜悦的东西。

sentences.en: But when the last spark went out, the courtyard stayed dark a breath too long, and the stars above looked fewer than before.
sentences.cn: 但最后一缕火星熄灭时，院子暗了一个呼吸的功夫太久，上面的星辰看起来比之前少了。

reality:2.en: I asked Master Qingwu whether the words we learned were only symbols. She set down her brush and looked at the clouds below. 'The *reality* is that every word you master changes the mountain, however slightly.' I looked at my notes and saw, for the first time, faint light lifting off the page like morning mist.
reality:2.cnHint: 师尊告诉我，我们所学的每一个词语都会改变山峰，这就是____。
reality:2.hook: Light from my own notes had never risen before tonight.
reality:2.line: 'The *reality*, young disciple, is that words here are never merely words.'

sentences.en: I asked Master Qingwu whether the words we learned were only symbols.
sentences.cn: 我问青梧师尊，我们学的词语是不是只是符号。

sentences.en: She set down her brush and looked at the clouds below.
sentences.cn: 她放下笔，看向下方的云。

sentences.en: 'The *reality* is that every word you master changes the mountain, however slightly.'
I looked at my notes and saw, for the first time, faint light lifting off the page like morning mist.
sentences.cn: 我低头看我的笔记，头一次看到淡淡的光从纸页上升起，像晨雾一样。

beyond:2.en: The old map ended at the Eastern Ridge, but Xiaoxing pointed to a faint ink trail that continued past the border. 'There is something *beyond* the last marked peak,' she whispered, pressing her finger gently on the blank paper. The ink trail moved — slowly, like a worm waking — and extended itself one more ridge further.
beyond:2.cnHint: 师妹发现地图上有一条隐约的墨迹延伸到最后一座山峰____。
beyond:2.hook: The ink moved again while no one was touching the map.
beyond:2.line: 'Look — the trail goes *beyond* the last peak, and it is still moving.'

sentences.en: The old map ended at the Eastern Ridge, but Xiaoxing pointed to a faint ink trail that continued past the border.
sentences.cn: 老地图在东岭处断了，小杏指向一条隐隐约约的墨迹，它延伸过了边界。

sentences.en: 'There is something *beyond* the last marked peak,' she whispered, pressing her finger gently on the blank paper.
The ink trail moved — slowly, like a worm waking — and extended itself one more ridge further.
sentences.cn: 那条墨迹动了——缓缓地，像一条虫子在醒来——又向外延伸了一道岭。

completely:2.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a cracked spirit-stone and told me to fill it with a single word, *completely*, until no hollow space remained inside. I breathed the word in slow, and the cracks sealed one by one. When the stone was whole, it rang like a bell — one clear note that rolled off the mountain and did not echo back.
completely:2.cnHint: 师兄让我用一个词____地充满一块破损的灵石，直到没有空隙为止。
completely:2.hook: A sound that leaves a mountain should always return — this one did not.
completely:2.line: 'Fill it *completely* — if even one crack stays empty, the stone will break again.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a cracked spirit-stone and told me to fill it with a single word, *completely*, until no hollow space remained inside.
I breathed the word in slow, and the cracks sealed one by one.
sentences.cn: 我缓缓地把那个词吸了进去，裂纹一条条地封上了。

sentences.en: When the stone was whole, it rang like a bell — one clear note that rolled off the mountain and did not echo back.
sentences.cn: 石头完整时，它响了——一个清亮的音符，从山上滚落下来，没有回声。

advise:2.en: Before dawn, Master Qingwu left a single slip of paper on my door. On it she had written: 'I *advise* you to learn the word for stillness before the storm word finds you.' I read it three times. By the third reading the paper had grown cold in my hands, and thin ice had formed along its edges.
advise:2.cnHint: 师尊留下字条____我先学会静字，以免风暴之词先找到我。
advise:2.hook: Ice on paper, in summer, is not a thing that happens by chance.
advise:2.line: 'I *advise* you, above all else, to learn stillness before the storm arrives.'

sentences.en: Before dawn, Master Qingwu left a single slip of paper on my door.
sentences.cn: 天亮前，青梧师尊在我的门上留了一张纸条。

sentences.en: On it she had written: 'I *advise* you to learn the word for stillness before the storm word finds you.'
I read it three times.
sentences.cn: 我读了三遍。

sentences.en: By the third reading the paper had grown cold in my hands, and thin ice had formed along its edges.
sentences.cn: 第三遍时纸在我手里已经冷了，边缘结了薄冰。

describe:2.en: The old stone wall near the library held a message carved in glowing script. I tried to *describe* the symbols to Shen Wujiu — spirals like wind, lines like rain — but my words kept failing. He listened, then traced one glyph with his finger. 'This is the word for thunder,' he said softly. Somewhere above us, the sky agreed.
describe:2.cnHint: 我试图向师兄____那面石壁上发光的符文，却发现言语总是不够用。
describe:2.hook: The last glyph pulsed once, then went dark.
describe:2.line: 'Can you *describe* the shape of the light before it faded?'

sentences.en: The old stone wall near the library held a message carved in glowing script.
sentences.cn: 图书馆边的老石墙上刻着用光芒书写的讯息。

sentences.en: I tried to *describe* the symbols to Shen Wujiu — spirals like wind, lines like rain — but my words kept failing.
He listened, then traced one glyph with his finger.
sentences.cn: 他听着，然后用指尖描了一个字符。

sentences.en: 'This is the word for thunder,' he said softly.
sentences.cn: "这是雷的字，"他轻声说。

sentences.en: Somewhere above us, the sky agreed.
sentences.cn: 我们上方的天空应和了他。

rest:2.en: Xiaoxing found me asleep against the medicine shelf, an open scroll across my lap. She set a warm cup beside me without a word. 'Even spiritual herbs need *rest* between harvests,' she said when I stirred. I smiled, reached for the cup — and noticed a single black feather lying across the scroll's final line.
rest:2.cnHint: 小师妹发现我在药架旁睡着了，轻声说连灵草也需要____。
