rest:2.hook: The black feather had not been there before I closed my eyes.
rest:2.line: 'Take your *rest* now — the storm will not wait for tired disciples.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing found me asleep against the medicine shelf, an open scroll across my lap.
sentences.cn: 小杏发现我睡在药架边，一卷打开的文书横放在我腿上。

sentences.en: She set a warm cup beside me without a word.
sentences.cn: 她无声地在我旁边放了一杯温热的茶。

sentences.en: 'Even spiritual herbs need *rest* between harvests,' she said when I stirred.
I smiled, reached for the cup — and noticed a single black feather lying across the scroll's final line.
sentences.cn: 我笑了，伸手去拿杯子——然后看到一根黑色的羽毛躺在文书的最后一行上。

employer:2.en: A sealed letter arrived at the gate bearing no name. The gatekeeper said a stranger had left it, calling Master Qingwu their former *employer*. I carried it up the stone steps with careful hands. Master Qingwu read it once, folded it slowly, and placed it inside her robe without a word. The candle between us bent toward her, as if listening.
employer:2.cnHint: 一封信中，有人称青雾师尊是自己昔日的____，师尊看后沉默不语。
employer:2.hook: She had not blinked once while reading.
employer:2.line: 'Whoever calls Master Qingwu their *employer* has walked a very dangerous road.'

sentences.en: A sealed letter arrived at the gate bearing no name.
sentences.cn: 一封密封的信到了山门，上面没有名字。

sentences.en: The gatekeeper said a stranger had left it, calling Master Qingwu their former *employer*.
I carried it up the stone steps with careful hands.
sentences.cn: 我小心翼翼地拿着它上了石阶。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu read it once, folded it slowly, and placed it inside her robe without a word.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊读了一遍，慢慢折起来，塞进了衣袍里，什么也没说。

sentences.en: The candle between us bent toward her, as if listening.
sentences.cn: 我们之间的蜡烛向她倾斜，仿佛在听。

owner:2.en: A jade box sat unclaimed on the courtyard steps for three days. Shen Wujiu asked every disciple, but no one admitted to being its *owner*. On the fourth morning I opened it: inside lay a single seed that glowed faint gold. Master Qingwu arrived before I could speak, as though she had felt it from across the mountain.
owner:2.cnHint: 一只无人认领的玉盒放了三天，没有人承认自己是它的____。
owner:2.hook: The seed began to hum the moment Master Qingwu's shadow touched it.
owner:2.line: 'If no *owner* steps forward by dawn, the sect must decide what this means.'

sentences.en: A jade box sat unclaimed on the courtyard steps for three days.
sentences.cn: 一个玉盒在院子的台阶上搁了三天没人要。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu asked every disciple, but no one admitted to being its *owner*.
On the fourth morning I opened it: inside lay a single seed that glowed faint gold.
sentences.cn: 第四个早晨我打开了它：里面躺着一粒发出淡金光的种子。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu arrived before I could speak, as though she had felt it from across the mountain.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在我还没开口前就到了，仿佛她从山的另一头就感受到了它。

gender:2.en: The archive held records of every disciple in Cloud Sea Sect history — name, age, mountain, and *gender*, each brushed in careful ink. I searched for my own entry and found it, but below my name someone had added a second line in a different hand. The words were in a script I could not yet read. I looked around; the archive was empty.
gender:2.cnHint: 典籍中记录着每位弟子的姓名、年龄、所在山峰与____，我在自己名字下发现了一行陌生的字迹。
gender:2.hook: The second line had not been there yesterday — I was certain of it.
gender:2.line: '*Gender*, age, mountain — every field is filled except the one that matters most.'

sentences.en: The archive held records of every disciple in Cloud Sea Sect history — name, age, mountain, and *gender*, each brushed in careful ink.
I searched for my own entry and found it, but below my name someone had added a second line in a different hand.
sentences.cn: 我查找自己的条目，找到了，但在我的名字下面有人用另一种笔迹又加了一行。

sentences.en: The words were in a script I could not yet read.
sentences.cn: 那些字是我还读不了的字体。

sentences.en: I looked around; the archive was empty.
sentences.cn: 我看了看四周；档案馆是空的。

website:2.en: A traveler from the lowlands brought strange news: a glowing board in the valley market displayed moving words, and the village elders called it a *website* — a place where knowledge floated free for anyone to take. Shen Wujiu laughed softly. 'Words without a master are dangerous things,' he said. That night, three message-birds arrived at once, each carrying the same single word.
website:2.cnHint: 来自山下的旅人带来了关于____的消息，师兄却说无主之词十分危险。
website:2.hook: All three birds bore the same word: 'Run.'
website:2.line: 'Even a *website* in the valley cannot hold the words that escaped last night.'

sentences.en: A traveler from the lowlands brought strange news: a glowing board in the valley market displayed moving words, and the village elders called it a *website* — a place where knowledge floated free for anyone to take.
Shen Wujiu laughed softly.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎轻轻地笑了。

sentences.en: 'Words without a master are dangerous things,' he said.
sentences.cn: "没有主人的词语是危险的东西，"他说。

sentences.en: That night, three message-birds arrived at once, each carrying the same single word.
sentences.cn: 那晚，三只信鸟一起到了，每一只都带来了同一个词。

emotional:2.en: Xiaoxing stood before the Feeling Stone, the sect's old test of inner balance. Her face was calm, but the stone glowed a deep red — a sign that her state was too *emotional* for the next level of practice. She stepped back, breathing slowly. I watched her hands still like water at rest. The stone shifted to pale gold. Then it cracked straight down the center.
emotional:2.cnHint: 小师妹站在感情石前，石头的红光显示她的内心状态太过____，于是她开始调息。
emotional:2.hook: No stone had ever cracked before — not in three hundred years of sect records.
emotional:2.line: 'Being *emotional* is not weakness — but today the stone demands stillness.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing stood before the Feeling Stone, the sect's old test of inner balance.
sentences.cn: 小杏站在感心石前，这是宗派里测试内心平衡的老法子。

sentences.en: Her face was calm, but the stone glowed a deep red — a sign that her state was too *emotional* for the next level of practice.
She stepped back, breathing slowly.
sentences.cn: 她退了一步，慢慢地呼吸。

sentences.en: I watched her hands still like water at rest.
sentences.cn: 我看着她的手像静水一样平静了下来。

sentences.en: The stone shifted to pale gold.
sentences.cn: 石头转向了淡金色。

sentences.en: Then it cracked straight down the center.
sentences.cn: 然后它从中心裂成了两半。

training:2.en: Master Qingwu led me to a narrow bridge above the deepest part of the cloud sea. She said nothing about the day's *training* until I stepped onto the first plank. Then: 'Speak the word for balance. Speak it until you believe it.' I spoke it seventeen times before the bridge stopped shaking. On the eighteenth step, a second shadow appeared beside mine — though we were alone.
training:2.cnHint: 青雾师尊带我到云海上的窄桥，开始了今天的____，要求我反复念出"平衡"一词。
training:2.hook: The second shadow pointed back toward the sect gate.
training:2.line: 'Your *training* today has one rule: do not look down, no matter what you hear.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu led me to a narrow bridge above the deepest part of the cloud sea.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊领我走过云海最深处的一座狭窄桥梁。

sentences.en: She said nothing about the day's *training* until I stepped onto the first plank.
Then: 'Speak the word for balance.
sentences.cn: 然后说："说出平衡的字。

sentences.en: Speak it until you believe it.'
sentences.cn: 一遍遍说，直到你相信它。"

sentences.en: I spoke it seventeen times before the bridge stopped shaking.
sentences.cn: 我说了十七遍，桥才停止摇晃。

sentences.en: On the eighteenth step, a second shadow appeared beside mine — though we were alone.
sentences.cn: 第十八步时，我的影子边上出现了第二道身影——虽然我们是独自一人。

responsibility:2.en: Master Qingwu placed a sealed scroll into my hands at the edge of the Library Cliff. 'Every word inside is a living herb,' she said quietly. 'Guard it.' The weight was small, but I felt the full *responsibility* settle across my shoulders like a mountain range pressing down through cloud.
responsibility:2.cnHint: 师尊将一卷封印的书卷交给我，让我感受到了沉重的____。
responsibility:2.hook: Behind me, a single page slipped free and dissolved into mist.
responsibility:2.line: 'You now carry the *responsibility* for every word inside that scroll.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu placed a sealed scroll into my hands at the edge of the Library Cliff.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在藏书崖边把一卷封好的书简放进我手里。

sentences.en: 'Every word inside is a living herb,' she said quietly.
sentences.cn: "里面的每个字都是活的草药，"她轻声说。

sentences.en: 'Guard it.'
sentences.cn: 把它守好。

sentences.en: The weight was small, but I felt the full *responsibility* settle across my shoulders like a mountain range pressing down through cloud.

soon:2.en: Shen Wujiu found me at the base of the wind-stairs, tracing the carved syllables with my finger. 'The sky above the third peak turns copper before a trial,' he said, voice low. 'That color has not appeared in seven years. It will come *soon*.' He said nothing more and walked away into the pale morning fog.
soon:2.cnHint: 师兄告诉我，天空变铜色预示着考验____就会来临。
soon:2.hook: Above us, the third peak caught the first faint trace of copper light.
soon:2.line: 'The trial will come *soon* — prepare your core words tonight.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu found me at the base of the wind-stairs, tracing the carved syllables with my finger.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在风梯基部找到我，我正用手指描着刻在石头上的音节。

sentences.en: 'The sky above the third peak turns copper before a trial,' he said, voice low.
sentences.cn: "第三峰上方的天空在试炼前会变成铜色，"他的嗓音很低。

sentences.en: 'That color has not appeared in seven years.
sentences.cn: 那种颜色已经七年没出现过了。

sentences.en: It will come *soon*.'
He said nothing more and walked away into the pale morning fog.
sentences.cn: 他什么都没再说，走进了苍白的晨雾里。

center:2.en: Xiaoxing led me through the Mist Archive, a room where scrolls floated in slow circles. At its *center* stood a single stone pillar, and carved into it was one word so old that no one could read it aloud. She whispered that the whole sect had been built around that pillar, that the word was the sect's oldest healing formula.
center:2.cnHint: 师妹带我看到了迷雾档案馆____的那根石柱，上面刻着无人能读出的字。
center:2.hook: Then I saw the crack running up the pillar from base to crown.
center:2.line: 'Everything in this sect grows around the *center* pillar — never touch it.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing led me through the Mist Archive, a room where scrolls floated in slow circles.
sentences.cn: 小杏带我穿过雾气藏书室，那是一个书简缓缓旋转的房间。

sentences.en: At its *center* stood a single stone pillar, and carved into it was one word so old that no one could read it aloud.
She whispered that the whole sect had been built around that pillar, that the word was the sect's oldest healing formula.
sentences.cn: 她低声说，整个宗派就是围绕那根柱子建起来的，那个字是宗派最古老的疗愈法诀。

arrive:2.en: I was copying water-formulas in the outer hall when the bell rang three slow times. Shen Wujiu appeared at the doorway, breathing hard. 'The examination envoys *arrive* at dawn,' he said. 'They carry word-keys that can lock a disciple's voice for a full season.' My brush stopped moving on its own.
arrive:2.cnHint: 师兄告诉我考试使者将在黎明____，他们能封住弟子的声音。
arrive:2.hook: Outside, three lanterns appeared in the cloud sea where no path existed.
arrive:2.line: 'When the envoys *arrive*, keep your strongest word sealed inside your chest.'

sentences.en: I was copying water-formulas in the outer hall when the bell rang three slow times.
sentences.cn: 我在外殿抄写水法诀时，钟敲了三次，声音缓慢。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu appeared at the doorway, breathing hard.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎出现在门口，喘着气。

sentences.en: 'The examination envoys *arrive* at dawn,' he said.
'They carry word-keys that can lock a disciple's voice for a full season.'
sentences.cn: "他们携带的字钥可以把弟子的声音锁住整整一个季节。"

sentences.en: My brush stopped moving on its own.
sentences.cn: 我的笔自己停了下来。

boost:2.en: Xiaoxing handed me a small clay jar before the morning forms. Inside was a paste made from three spoken syllables pressed into herb oil. 'One breath of this will *boost* the reach of any word you cast,' she said, 'but only for a single heartbeat, so choose the moment well.' The jar was warm, almost alive.
boost:2.cnHint: 师妹给了我一个小罐子，说它能____我施法的力量，但只有一瞬间。
boost:2.hook: The jar pulsed once in my palm, then went cold and still.
boost:2.line: 'This paste will *boost* your word-cast — but spend it only at the peak moment.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing handed me a small clay jar before the morning forms.
sentences.cn: 小杏在晨练前递给我一个小陶罐。

sentences.en: Inside was a paste made from three spoken syllables pressed into herb oil.
sentences.cn: 里面是用三个说出来的音节压进草药油里做成的膏。

sentences.en: 'One breath of this will *boost* the reach of any word you cast,' she said, 'but only for a single heartbeat, so choose the moment well.'
The jar was warm, almost alive.
sentences.cn: 罐子是温热的，几乎有了生命。

conflict:2.en: In the narrow pass between the second and third peaks, I found two formulas carved on facing walls. Shen Wujiu explained that the two word-lines *conflict*: speaking them together causes the air to split and any healing intent to reverse into harm. Someone had tried to combine them recently — the stone between was scorched black.
conflict:2.cnHint: 两道咒文相互____，师兄警告我绝对不能同时念出它们。
conflict:2.hook: A hairline crack in the scorched stone was slowly spreading toward both walls.
conflict:2.line: 'These two formulas *conflict* — chanting both at once will turn healing into harm.'

sentences.en: In the narrow pass between the second and third peaks, I found two formulas carved on facing walls.
sentences.cn: 在第二和第三峰之间的狭隘通道里，我找到了刻在相对两面墙上的两个法诀。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu explained that the two word-lines *conflict*: speaking them together causes the air to split and any healing intent to reverse into harm.
Someone had tried to combine them recently — the stone between was scorched black.
sentences.cn: 有人最近试过把它们结合起来——中间的石头被烧成了焦黑。

demand:2.en: The sealed gate at the cliff's edge had not opened in a generation. When I pressed my hand to the stone, it spoke in a low hum that only I seemed to hear. It did not ask a question — it issued a clear *demand*: give one word you have never spoken aloud to anyone, surrender it completely, and the way would open.
demand:2.cnHint: 悬崖边的封印石门向我发出____，要我献出一个从未说出口的字。
demand:2.hook: Deep in my chest, one word began to rise without my asking.
demand:2.line: 'The gate will *demand* one unspoken word — think carefully before you give it.'

sentences.en: The sealed gate at the cliff's edge had not opened in a generation.
sentences.cn: 悬崖边的封闭之门已经一代人没有打开过了。

sentences.en: When I pressed my hand to the stone, it spoke in a low hum that only I seemed to hear.
sentences.cn: 当我把手按在石头上时，它用只有我能听见的低沉嗡鸣声说话。

sentences.en: It did not ask a question — it issued a clear *demand*: give one word you have never spoken aloud to anyone, surrender it completely, and the way would open.

emotion:2.en: Master Qingwu stopped my recitation at the seventh line. 'You speak the words correctly,' she said, 'but the formula hears *emotion* as well as sound. Right now yours is scattered — part fear, part pride, nothing whole.' She closed her eyes and waited. I breathed, found one clean feeling, and began again from the first syllable.
emotion:2.cnHint: 师尊说咒文能感受到弟子的____，让我找到一种纯粹的感情再重新开始。
emotion:2.hook: On my second attempt, the candle flame rose three times its normal height.
emotion:2.line: 'A formula reads your *emotion* as clearly as it reads your voice — steady both.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu stopped my recitation at the seventh line.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在第七行停止了我的吟诵。

sentences.en: 'You speak the words correctly,' she said, 'but the formula hears *emotion* as well as sound.
Right now yours is scattered — part fear, part pride, nothing whole.'
sentences.cn: 现在你的感情混乱——一半是恐惧，一半是骄傲，没有整体。

sentences.en: She closed her eyes and waited.
sentences.cn: 她闭上眼睛等待着。

sentences.en: I breathed, found one clean feeling, and began again from the first syllable.
sentences.cn: 我深吸一口气，找到一个纯净的感受，从第一个音节重新开始。

consume:2.en: The old scroll warned that casting the word 'tempest' would *consume* a full day's worth of spiritual energy in a single breath. I read the warning three times, then folded the scroll and tucked it into my robe. Shen Wujiu had cast it twice before dawn. Outside, the clouds below our mountain began to spin.
consume:2.cnHint: 古卷轴警告说，施展'tempest'这个词会将一天的灵力____一空，而师兄黎明前已经施展了两次。
consume:2.hook: The spinning clouds below our peak had no natural cause.
consume:2.line: 'One casting will *consume* everything you have stored since winter.'

sentences.en: The old scroll warned that casting the word 'tempest' would *consume* a full day's worth of spiritual energy in a single breath.
I read the warning three times, then folded the scroll and tucked it into my robe.
sentences.cn: 我读了三遍警告，然后折起书简塞进了衣袍。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu had cast it twice before dawn.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在天亮前已经施过两次。

sentences.en: Outside, the clouds below our mountain began to spin.
sentences.cn: 在外面，我们山下的云开始旋转。

desire:2.en: Master Qingwu placed a single seed-word on the stone table between us. It glowed faint gold. She said nothing, only watched my face. I felt it clearly — a pull deep in my chest, a *desire* to reach out and swallow the word whole, to feel its power root itself in my breath. I kept my hands still. The gold light pulsed once, then dimmed.
desire:2.cnHint: 师尊将一个种子词放在石桌上，我感受到胸口深处有一种强烈的____，想要将它吞下。
desire:2.hook: The dimming light left a shape burned into the stone.
desire:2.line: 'Tell me honestly — do you *desire* the word, or do you desire what it can do?'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu placed a single seed-word on the stone table between us.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在我们之间的石桌上放了一个单独的种子字。

sentences.en: It glowed faint gold.
sentences.cn: 它泛着淡金色的光。

sentences.en: She said nothing, only watched my face.
sentences.cn: 她什么都没说，只是看着我的脸。

sentences.en: I felt it clearly — a pull deep in my chest, a *desire* to reach out and swallow the word whole, to feel its power root itself in my breath.
I kept my hands still.
sentences.cn: 我的手保持不动。

sentences.en: The gold light pulsed once, then dimmed.
sentences.cn: 金色的光脉动了一次，然后变暗。

meal:2.en: After the morning lesson, Xiaoxing brought a wooden tray to the terrace: rice, two soft vegetables, a bowl of clear broth. 'A proper *meal* before a trial,' she said quietly, setting it down without looking at me. I noticed she had not brought a tray for herself. The broth was warm and tasted faintly of the herb-word 'calm.'
meal:2.cnHint: 小星在考验前为我送来了一顿____，但她自己却没有带托盘。
meal:2.hook: The herb-word 'calm' should not have been in the kitchen stores.
meal:2.line: 'Eat the whole *meal* — you will not get another chance before the trial begins.'

sentences.en: After the morning lesson, Xiaoxing brought a wooden tray to the terrace: rice, two soft vegetables, a bowl of clear broth.
sentences.cn: 晨课结束后，小杏端着一个木托盘来到露台：米饭、两样软菜、一碗清汤。

sentences.en: 'A proper *meal* before a trial,' she said quietly, setting it down without looking at me.
I noticed she had not brought a tray for herself.
sentences.cn: 我注意到她没有给自己端一份托盘。

sentences.en: The broth was warm and tasted faintly of the herb-word 'calm.'
sentences.cn: 汤是温热的，隐隐有着"宁静"这个草药字的味道。

vegetable:2.en: The sect's herb-garden was not a garden at all. Each *vegetable* growing in the long clay pots was also a living word: touch the leaf of the narrow green one and your tongue shaped the sound for 'shield'; bite the root of the pale round one and your lungs filled with 'ascend.' I had been told to water them. I was afraid to brush a single leaf by mistake.
vegetable:2.cnHint: 宗门的草药园里，每一株____同时也是一个活着的词语，碰触它就会触发不同的法诀。
vegetable:2.hook: One pot at the far end held a plant no one had named for me.
vegetable:2.line: 'Every *vegetable* in this row encodes a word older than the sect itself.'

sentences.en: The sect's herb-garden was not a garden at all.
sentences.cn: 宗门的药园根本不是个园子。

sentences.en: Each *vegetable* growing in the long clay pots was also a living word: touch the leaf of the narrow green one and your tongue shaped the sound for 'shield'; bite the root of the pale round one and your lungs filled with 'ascend.'
I had been told to water them.
sentences.cn: 我被吩咐去浇水。

sentences.en: I was afraid to brush a single leaf by mistake.
sentences.cn: 我害怕一不小心碰到任何一片叶子。

adopt:2.en: Shen Wujiu unrolled a thin practice sheet and smoothed it flat on the railing. 'You must *adopt* a slower breath pattern when you write fire-words,' he said, demonstrating: long in, hold, short out. 'Master Qingwu taught me this in my first month. It is not natural at first. Your body will resist.' Below us the sea of clouds caught the last red light of dusk.
adopt:2.cnHint: 师兄告诉我，书写火焰词语时必须____一种更缓慢的呼吸方式，否则身体会抵抗。
adopt:2.hook: The red light below deepened to a color that had no name in any scroll.
adopt:2.line: '*Adopt* the slow breath now, before the characters grow too warm to hold.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu unrolled a thin practice sheet and smoothed it flat on the railing.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎摊开一张薄薄的练习纸，在栏杆上铺平。

sentences.en: 'You must *adopt* a slower breath pattern when you write fire-words,' he said, demonstrating: long in, hold, short out.
'Master Qingwu taught me this in my first month.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在我入门第一个月就教过我这个。

sentences.en: It is not natural at first.
sentences.cn: 一开始不自然。

sentences.en: Your body will resist.'
sentences.cn: 你的身体会抗拒。

sentences.en: Below us the sea of clouds caught the last red light of dusk.
sentences.cn: 我们下方的云海捕捉到了黄昏最后一抹红光。

miss:2.en: A folded note appeared under my door before I woke. The handwriting was Xiaoxing's, small and careful: 'Do not *miss* the hour before sunrise — the gate at the northern edge will be open, and something is written on the stone inside that was not there yesterday.' I dressed in the dark and stepped out. The floating mountain was perfectly still and perfectly silent.
miss:2.cnHint: 小星留下一张便条，提醒我不要____黎明前的那段时间，北门的石头上出现了新的文字。
miss:2.hook: The silence on a cultivation mountain is never a good sign.
miss:2.line: 'If you *miss* the hour, the writing may be gone — it happened once before.'

sentences.en: A folded note appeared under my door before I woke.
sentences.cn: 我还没醒，一张折叠的纸条就出现在门下。

sentences.en: The handwriting was Xiaoxing's, small and careful: 'Do not *miss* the hour before sunrise — the gate at the northern edge will be open, and something is written on the stone inside that was not there yesterday.'
I dressed in the dark and stepped out.
sentences.cn: 我在黑暗中换好衣服，走了出去。

sentences.en: The floating mountain was perfectly still and perfectly silent.
sentences.cn: 浮山完全静止，完全无声。

yourself:2.en: Master Qingwu did not demonstrate the word 'endure.' She handed me the brush and stepped back. 'Write it *yourself*,' she said. 'I can show you the shape of every character in this sect's archive, but the word only becomes yours when your own breath drives the ink.' My hand shook slightly. The brush touched the paper and the air in the room grew heavy and still.
yourself:2.cnHint: 师尊让我____书写'endure'这个词，因为只有当自己的呼吸驱动墨水时，词语才真正属于你。
yourself:2.hook: The heavy air pressed down as if the word were already waking.
yourself:2.line: 'You must experience it *yourself* — no one else's breath can bind that word to you.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu did not demonstrate the word 'endure.'
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊没有示范"忍"这个字。

sentences.en: She handed me the brush and stepped back.
sentences.cn: 她把笔递给我，退到了身后。

sentences.en: 'Write it *yourself*,' she said.
'I can show you the shape of every character in this sect's archive, but the word only becomes yours when your own breath drives the ink.'
sentences.cn: 我可以给你看宗派档案里每个字的笔画，但只有你自己的气息驱动墨汁时，这个字才真正属于你。

sentences.en: My hand shook slightly.
sentences.cn: 我的手微微发颤。

sentences.en: The brush touched the paper and the air in the room grew heavy and still.
sentences.cn: 笔尖触到纸面，房间里的空气陡然沉重了，静止了。

century:2.en: The sealed room beneath the main hall had not been opened in over a *century*, Shen Wujiu told me, keeping his voice low. The lock was a word-lock: speak the right syllable and the stone door would recognize it. No one alive knew the syllable. He pressed his ear to the door for a moment, then straightened. 'It is speaking,' he said. 'Very softly. But it is speaking.'
century:2.cnHint: 主殿下方那间密室已经超过一个____没有开启，而师兄说他听到里面传出了声音。
century:2.hook: A locked door that speaks is waiting for something to answer it.
century:2.line: 'This door has held its secret for a *century* — and now it has decided to talk.'

sentences.en: The sealed room beneath the main hall had not been opened in over a *century*, Shen Wujiu told me, keeping his voice low.
The lock was a word-lock: speak the right syllable and the stone door would recognize it.
sentences.cn: 锁是个字锁——说出正确的音节，石门就会认出来。

sentences.en: No one alive knew the syllable.
sentences.cn: 活着的人中没人知道那个音节。

sentences.en: He pressed his ear to the door for a moment, then straightened.
sentences.cn: 他把耳朵贴在门上片刻，然后直起身。

sentences.en: 'It is speaking,' he said.
sentences.cn: 它在说话，他说。

sentences.en: 'Very softly.
sentences.cn: 声音很小。

sentences.en: But it is speaking.'
sentences.cn: 但它确实在说话。

management:2.en: In the archive hall, I unrolled a scroll older than the sect itself. It described the *management* of rare word-seeds — how to store them in jade jars, how to feed them morning mist, how to keep their meanings from fading. Shen Wujiu stood at the door, watching the clouds below the mountain darken.
management:2.cnHint: 我在典籍阁发现了一卷记载珍稀字种____方法的古老卷轴。
management:2.hook: The last line of the scroll was written in a hand that trembled.
management:2.line: 'The *management* of these seeds is a duty no one here has kept for thirty years.'

sentences.en: In the archive hall, I unrolled a scroll older than the sect itself.
sentences.cn: 在档案厅，我摊开了一卷比宗门本身还古老的书卷。

sentences.en: It described the *management* of rare word-seeds — how to store them in jade jars, how to feed them morning mist, how to keep their meanings from fading.
Shen Wujiu stood at the door, watching the clouds below the mountain darken.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎站在门口，看着山下的云逐渐暗了下来。

perfect:2.en: Xiaoxing handed me a smooth stone carved with a single word. She said it was the *perfect* vessel for carrying a healing formula through a storm — the stone would not crack, and the word inside would not scatter. I held it and felt a faint warmth, like a breath caught just before sleep.
perfect:2.cnHint: 小星把一块雕着疗愈字符的石头交给我，说它是穿越风暴的____容器。
perfect:2.hook: Then the warmth turned cold between my fingers.
perfect:2.line: 'This is the *perfect* vessel — do not let it leave your hand tonight.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing handed me a smooth stone carved with a single word.
sentences.cn: 小杏递给我一块光滑的石头，上面刻了一个字。

sentences.en: She said it was the *perfect* vessel for carrying a healing formula through a storm — the stone would not crack, and the word inside would not scatter.
I held it and felt a faint warmth, like a breath caught just before sleep.
sentences.cn: 我拿着它，感觉到淡淡的温暖，像一口在睡眠前被捕捉住的呼吸。

along:2.en: I walked *along* the narrow stone path that runs the edge of our mountain, reading the carved words set into the railing. Each word was a warning left by a disciple who had survived a heavenly trial. Near the end of the path, one stone was blank, freshly cut, still pale against the old grey rock.
along:2.cnHint: 我____山边小径行走，读着前人刻下的字符警示，却发现最后一块石头空白如新。
along:2.hook: No name, no date — only a single drop of dried ink.
along:2.line: 'Walk *along* this path every night before the trial — let the old words settle into you.'

sentences.en: I walked *along* the narrow stone path that runs the edge of our mountain, reading the carved words set into the railing.
Each word was a warning left by a disciple who had survived a heavenly trial.
sentences.cn: 每一个字都是曾活过来度过天劫的弟子留下的警告。

sentences.en: Near the end of the path, one stone was blank, freshly cut, still pale against the old grey rock.
sentences.cn: 在路的尾端，有一块石头是空白的，刚切过，在古老灰色的岩石中显得苍白。

harm:2.en: Master Qingwu placed a sealed jar on the table and told me the word inside could *harm* as easily as it could heal — the difference lay only in the breath used to release it. I nodded, but my hands were not steady. Outside, a low bell rang once across the cloud sea.
harm:2.cnHint: 师尊告诉我，瓶中的字符既能治愈也能____，区别只在于释放时的气息。
harm:2.hook: The bell was not the evening bell — it was too early, too low.
harm:2.line: 'Used without care, this word will *harm* the one who speaks it first.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu placed a sealed jar on the table and told me the word inside could *harm* as easily as it could heal — the difference lay only in the breath used to release it.
I nodded, but my hands were not steady.
sentences.cn: 我点头，但手不太稳。

sentences.en: Outside, a low bell rang once across the cloud sea.
sentences.cn: 外面，一声低沉的钟声在云海上敲响。

increasingly:2.en: As the trial approached, the words in my practice scrolls became *increasingly* hard to hold still. Letters shifted when I blinked; meanings slipped like wet stone underfoot. Shen Wujiu said this was normal — the mountain itself grows restless before a heavenly storm. I was not sure I believed him.
increasingly:2.cnHint: 随着天劫临近，练习卷轴上的字符变得____难以稳定，如湿石般滑移。
increasingly:2.hook: By evening, two characters had vanished from the scroll entirely.
increasingly:2.line: 'The words grow *increasingly* unstable — copy them into your memory before they fade.'

sentences.en: As the trial approached, the words in my practice scrolls became *increasingly* hard to hold still.
Letters shifted when I blinked; meanings slipped like wet stone underfoot.
sentences.cn: 字母在我眨眼时移动；意思像湿润的石头一样在脚下滑落。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu said this was normal — the mountain itself grows restless before a heavenly storm.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎说这很正常——山在天劫来临前本身就会躁动。

sentences.en: I was not sure I believed him.
sentences.cn: 我不确定自己是否相信他。

opinion:2.en: Shen Wujiu found a folded note tucked inside my practice jar — a record of a senior disciple's *opinion* on the trial I was about to face. The note said the hardest part was not the storm but the silence just before it, when every word you had learned seemed to forget itself. I read it three times.
opinion:2.cnHint: 师兄在我的练习罐中发现了一张纸条，记录着前辈对即将到来的天劫的____。
opinion:2.hook: The note was signed with only an ink seal, no name.
opinion:2.line: 'My *opinion* is that you should memorise this note and then burn it.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu found a folded note tucked inside my practice jar — a record of a senior disciple's *opinion* on the trial I was about to face.
The note said the hardest part was not the storm but the silence just before it, when every word you had learned seemed to forget itself.
sentences.cn: 纸条说最困难的部分不是风暴本身，而是风暴前的沉默，那时你学过的每一个字都仿佛遗忘了自己。

sentences.en: I read it three times.
sentences.cn: 我读了三遍。

previous:2.en: In the lower archive I found a thin book listing every disciple's result in *previous* heavenly trials. Most names had a small mark beside them — passed, or did not return. One name near the middle had no mark at all, as if the recorder had paused and then chosen to write nothing.
previous:2.cnHint: 我在下层典籍阁找到了一本记录____历届天劫结果的薄册，其中一个名字旁空无一字。
previous:2.hook: The blank space beside that name still smelled faintly of ink.
previous:2.line: 'Study the *previous* trials — the storm repeats its patterns if you know where to look.'

sentences.en: In the lower archive I found a thin book listing every disciple's result in *previous* heavenly trials.
Most names had a small mark beside them — passed, or did not return.
sentences.cn: 大多数名字旁边有一个小标记——通过，或者没有归来。

sentences.en: One name near the middle had no mark at all, as if the recorder had paused and then chosen to write nothing.
sentences.cn: 中间一个名字旁没有任何标记，仿佛记录者停顿过，然后选择了什么都不写。

aim:2.en: Master Qingwu drew a circle in the air and told me that my *aim* in the trial was not to defeat the storm but to remain clear — to hold one word steady in my mind while everything around it dissolved. She closed her hand and the circle vanished. The cloud sea below the mountain flashed once with pale light.
aim:2.cnHint: 师尊告诉我，天劫中我的____不是战胜风暴，而是在一切消散时守住心中那一个字。
aim:2.hook: The pale light did not fade — it spread.
aim:2.line: 'Let your *aim* be one word, held still, no matter what the storm says to you.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu drew a circle in the air and told me that my *aim* in the trial was not to defeat the storm but to remain clear — to hold one word steady in my mind while everything around it dissolved.
She closed her hand and the circle vanished.
sentences.cn: 她合上手，圆圈消散了。

sentences.en: The cloud sea below the mountain flashed once with pale light.
sentences.cn: 山下的云海闪过一次苍白的光。

model:2.en: In the Archive Hall, I found a small stone *model* of the Cloud Sea Sect — every peak, every bridge, every gate carved with care. Master Qingwu had placed it here for new disciples to study. I traced each path with one finger, learning the mountain by touch before I ever climbed it.
model:2.cnHint: 我在藏档堂发现了云海宗的石制____，这是师尊为新弟子留下的。
model:2.hook: One peak on the model was missing — recently broken off.
model:2.line: 'This *model* shows every path — memorise it before you sleep.'

sentences.en: In the Archive Hall, I found a small stone *model* of the Cloud Sea Sect — every peak, every bridge, every gate carved with care.
Master Qingwu had placed it here for new disciples to study.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊把它放在这里给新弟子研习。

sentences.en: I traced each path with one finger, learning the mountain by touch before I ever climbed it.
sentences.cn: 我用一根手指描过每条路径，在真正登山之前，用触觉去学会这座山。

spot:2.en: Shen Wujiu led me along the outer bridge at dawn, pointing at the sea of clouds below. Suddenly he stopped. 'There,' he said quietly. I looked and managed to *spot* a faint silver glow drifting beneath the mist — a word-herb, rare and loose, not yet bound to any peak.
spot:2.cnHint: 师兄带我走在外桥上，我们____了一株在云雾中漂浮的珍稀字草。
spot:2.hook: Before either of us moved, the silver glow sank and vanished.
spot:2.line: 'Can you *spot* it through the mist? Look just below the third cloud layer.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu led me along the outer bridge at dawn, pointing at the sea of clouds below.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在晨曦中领我沿着外围的桥走，指向下方的云海。

sentences.en: Suddenly he stopped.
sentences.cn: 突然他停了下来。

sentences.en: 'There,' he said quietly.
sentences.cn: "那里，"他轻声说。

sentences.en: I looked and managed to *spot* a faint silver glow drifting beneath the mist — a word-herb, rare and loose, not yet bound to any peak.

achievement:2.en: Master Qingwu pinned a small jade slip to the notice board outside the training hall. It listed each disciple's name and one *achievement* earned that month. Beside my name were two plain words: 'first breath.' It was the smallest entry on the board, yet my hands would not stop shaking with quiet pride.
achievement:2.cnHint: 师尊在布告栏上列出了每位弟子本月的____，我看到了自己的名字。
achievement:2.hook: Below every name, a second line had been added in red ink — all blank except one.
achievement:2.line: 'One *achievement*, however small, is how every great path begins.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu pinned a small jade slip to the notice board outside the training hall.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊把一枚小玉简钉在训练厅外的公告板上。

sentences.en: It listed each disciple's name and one *achievement* earned that month.
Beside my name were two plain words: 'first breath.'
sentences.cn: 我的名字旁边是两个朴素的字："初息"。

sentences.en: It was the smallest entry on the board, yet my hands would not stop shaking with quiet pride.
sentences.cn: 这是公告板上最小的条目，可我的双手却因为安静的骄傲而无法停止颤抖。

enter:2.en: A sealed door stood at the far end of the Herb Library. Xiaoxing told me that only a disciple who could speak the correct word-formula aloud might *enter*. I stood before it for a long time, lips moving in silence, rehearsing. Then I spoke — and the door opened without a sound.
enter:2.cnHint: 药草阁尽头有一扇封印之门，只有念出正确字诀的弟子才能____。
enter:2.hook: Inside, every shelf was bare — and a single candle still burned.
enter:2.line: 'To *enter* that room, your words must be spoken from the heart, not memory.'

sentences.en: A sealed door stood at the far end of the Herb Library.
sentences.cn: 一扇密封的门矗立在草药库的最深处。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing told me that only a disciple who could speak the correct word-formula aloud might *enter*.
I stood before it for a long time, lips moving in silence, rehearsing.
sentences.cn: 我在它面前站了很久，嘴唇无声地动着，反复排练。

sentences.en: Then I spoke — and the door opened without a sound.
sentences.cn: 然后我开口说了——门无声地打开了。

eye:2.en: An old instruction scroll warned that a disciple's *eye* must be trained as carefully as the hand: to see a word-herb clearly is already half the work of gathering it. I had read the warning before, but only now, standing in fog so thick I could not see my own feet, did I truly understand it.
eye:2.cnHint: 一卷古老的教导卷轴说，弟子的____与手同样需要修炼。
eye:2.hook: When the fog shifted, something tall and still was standing right in front of me.
eye:2.line: 'Trust your *eye* before your hand — sight is the first step of every formula.'

sentences.en: An old instruction scroll warned that a disciple's *eye* must be trained as carefully as the hand: to see a word-herb clearly is already half the work of gathering it.
I had read the warning before, but only now, standing in fog so thick I could not see my own feet, did I truly understand it.
sentences.cn: 我以前读过这个警告，但只有现在，站在浓雾中看不见自己的脚，我才真正理解了它的含义。

shift:2.en: At midday the wind made a sudden *shift*, turning from west to north in a single breath. Every disciple on the training terrace felt it. Shen Wujiu looked up at once and said the wind only changes like that when the mountain itself is trying to speak — and we should listen.
shift:2.cnHint: 训练台上，风向突然发生了____，师兄说这是山在说话。
shift:2.hook: A low hum rose from the stone beneath our feet, then fell silent.
shift:2.line: 'That *shift* in the wind is not weather — something on the peak has woken.'

sentences.en: At midday the wind made a sudden *shift*, turning from west to north in a single breath.
Every disciple on the training terrace felt it.
sentences.cn: 训练台上的每个弟子都感受到了。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu looked up at once and said the wind only changes like that when the mountain itself is trying to speak — and we should listen.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎立刻抬起头，说风只有在山本身想说话时才会这样转变——我们应该听。

agree:2.en: Xiaoxing asked me to study the night-formula with her by the eastern lantern. I looked at my already-full scroll of notes, then at her hopeful face, and chose to *agree*. We sat together until the lantern oil ran low, and by the end I understood the formula in a way I had not managed alone.
agree:2.cnHint: 师妹邀我一起在东灯旁研读夜诀，我____了她的请求。
agree:2.hook: As we rolled up our scrolls, a shadow crossed the lantern flame from outside.
agree:2.line: 'Do you *agree* that the third line of the formula has been copied wrong in our scrolls?'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing asked me to study the night-formula with her by the eastern lantern.
sentences.cn: 小杏请我在东边的灯笼旁和她一起研习夜间法诀。

sentences.en: I looked at my already-full scroll of notes, then at her hopeful face, and chose to *agree*.
We sat together until the lantern oil ran low, and by the end I understood the formula in a way I had not managed alone.
sentences.cn: 我们坐在一起，直到灯油快要用完，最后我对这个法诀的理解达到了独自钻研无法企及的境地。

aware:2.en: I was copying a herb-chart in the quiet of the reading room when I became *aware* of a faint trembling in the floor — too steady to be wind, too slow to be footsteps. No one else seemed to notice. I pressed one palm flat against the stone and felt it again, patient and deep, like a second heartbeat.
aware:2.cnHint: 我在阅览室抄写药草图时，渐渐____到地板下有某种低沉的震动。
aware:2.hook: The trembling stopped the moment I lifted my hand from the stone.
aware:2.line: 'Be *aware* of what the mountain feels, not only what the eye can see.'

sentences.en: I was copying a herb-chart in the quiet of the reading room when I became *aware* of a faint trembling in the floor — too steady to be wind, too slow to be footsteps.
No one else seemed to notice.
sentences.cn: 其他人似乎都没有注意到。

sentences.en: I pressed one palm flat against the stone and felt it again, patient and deep, like a second heartbeat.
sentences.cn: 我把一只手掌紧贴在石头上，又感受到了它——耐心而深沉，像是第二颗心跳。

land:2.en: Master Qingwu unrolled an ancient scroll across the stone table. Its ink showed every floating peak of the Cloud Sea Sect, and far below them, a dark shape none of us had named. 'That shadow,' she said quietly, 'is the lost *land* our founders fled a thousand years ago.' The sea of clouds stirred as if it had heard her.
land:2.cnHint: 师尊展开古卷，指出云海深处那片被遗忘的____，云雾随之涌动。
land:2.hook: Below the clouds, something answered the scroll's glow.
land:2.line: 'That *land* below us has not forgotten the Sect.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu unrolled an ancient scroll across the stone table.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在石桌上展开了一卷古老的经卷。

sentences.en: Its ink showed every floating peak of the Cloud Sea Sect, and far below them, a dark shape none of us had named.
sentences.cn: 卷上的墨迹显示了云海宗的每一座浮峰，而在它们远下方，是一个我们都还没有命名过的黑影。

sentences.en: 'That shadow,' she said quietly, 'is the lost *land* our founders fled a thousand years ago.'
The sea of clouds stirred as if it had heard her.
sentences.cn: 云海随之翻涌，仿佛它听到了她的话。

promote:2.en: Shen Wujiu placed a small jade slip on my palm. Inside it burned the word 'ascend.' 'Master Qingwu chose this formula to *promote* your spirit root to the second level,' he said, his voice low and careful. 'She does not give it lightly.' Outside, the wind through the pine trees fell suddenly and completely still.
promote:2.cnHint: 师兄转交师尊亲选的玉简，说此字诀能____我的灵根境界，话音刚落，松风骤止。
promote:2.hook: The silence after his words felt older than the mountain.
promote:2.line: 'This word will *promote* your spirit root — use it at dawn.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu placed a small jade slip on my palm.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎把一枚小玉简放在我的掌心。

sentences.en: Inside it burned the word 'ascend.'
sentences.cn: 里面燃烧着"飞升"这个字。

sentences.en: 'Master Qingwu chose this formula to *promote* your spirit root to the second level,' he said, his voice low and careful.
'She does not give it lightly.'
sentences.cn: "她不会轻易给人这个。"

sentences.en: Outside, the wind through the pine trees fell suddenly and completely still.
sentences.cn: 屋外，松树间的风突然彻底静止了。

purchase:2.en: At the Cloud Market ledge, Xiaoxing held up a dried silver leaf sealed in wax. 'Every senior disciple makes one *purchase* before the heavenly trial,' she told me, pressing it into my hands. 'This herb steadies the mind when the sky breaks open.' I turned it over and saw, scratched into the wax, a warning I could not yet read.
purchase:2.cnHint: 师妹在云市为我做了一次____，说此草药能在天劫时定心，但封蜡上刻着我看不懂的警示。
purchase:2.hook: The scratched words on the wax began, very slowly, to glow.
purchase:2.line: 'My one *purchase* here — and it may be the most important one.'

sentences.en: At the Cloud Market ledge, Xiaoxing held up a dried silver leaf sealed in wax.
sentences.cn: 在云市的悬崖边，小杏举起了一片用蜡密封的干银叶。

sentences.en: 'Every senior disciple makes one *purchase* before the heavenly trial,' she told me, pressing it into my hands.
'This herb steadies the mind when the sky breaks open.'
sentences.cn: "这种草药在天空破裂时能稳定心神。"

sentences.en: I turned it over and saw, scratched into the wax, a warning I could not yet read.
sentences.cn: 我翻过来看，发现蜡上刻着一行我还读不懂的警告。

rely:2.en: I found the message tucked beneath my meditation mat: three words in Shen Wujiu's sharp hand — 'Do not *rely* on the wind formula alone tonight.' I read it twice. The wind formula was the only thing I had mastered. Above the peak, the sky had turned the deep, bruised color of an old wound.
rely:2.cnHint: 师兄留下字条，警告我今夜不可单独____风诀，而此刻山顶天色已如旧伤般深沉。
rely:2.hook: That bruised sky meant the trial would arrive before dawn.
rely:2.line: 'You cannot *rely* on one word when the heavens open.'

sentences.en: I found the message tucked beneath my meditation mat: three words in Shen Wujiu's sharp hand — 'Do not *rely* on the wind formula alone tonight.'
I read it twice.
sentences.cn: 我读了两遍。

sentences.en: The wind formula was the only thing I had mastered.
sentences.cn: 风诀是我唯一掌握的东西。

sentences.en: Above the peak, the sky had turned the deep, bruised color of an old wound.
sentences.cn: 峰顶上方，天色已经变成了陈旧伤口那样的深紫色。

connect:2.en: Xiaoxing drew two circles on the stone floor with white chalk: one for my spirit root, one for the sect's main peak. 'The trial will try to cut every thread between them,' she said. 'Your task is to *connect* them again before the last cloud burns away.' She looked up, and her eyes held something between sorrow and steady faith.
connect:2.cnHint: 师妹在地上画出灵根与主峰的关系，说天劫会斩断它们之间的联系，我须重新将二者____。
connect:2.hook: Overhead, the first thread of light snapped like a cut string.
connect:2.line: 'Find a way to *connect* your root to the peak — quickly.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing drew two circles on the stone floor with white chalk: one for my spirit root, one for the sect's main peak.
sentences.cn: 小杏用白粉笔在石地上画了两个圆：一个代表我的灵根，一个代表宗门主峰。

sentences.en: 'The trial will try to cut every thread between them,' she said.
sentences.cn: 她说，"这场试炼会切断它们之间的每一根线。"

sentences.en: 'Your task is to *connect* them again before the last cloud burns away.'
She looked up, and her eyes held something between sorrow and steady faith.
sentences.cn: 她抬起头，眼里混着悲伤和坚定的信念。

indicate:2.en: The old stone pillar at the sect gate bore seven carvings. Master Qingwu traced the sixth with one finger. 'All records *indicate* that the trial begins when this mark turns cold,' she said, without looking away from it. I pressed my own hand to the stone. It was already cold. She said nothing. Neither did I.
indicate:2.cnHint: 石柱上的古刻____天劫将至的时机，师尊抚上第六道刻痕时，我发现它已冰凉。
indicate:2.hook: Master Qingwu withdrew her hand and closed her eyes.
indicate:2.line: 'These marks *indicate* the trial is closer than we thought.'

sentences.en: The old stone pillar at the sect gate bore seven carvings.
sentences.cn: 宗门山门前的老石柱上刻着七道纹理。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu traced the sixth with one finger.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊用一根手指描过第六道。

sentences.en: 'All records *indicate* that the trial begins when this mark turns cold,' she said, without looking away from it.
I pressed my own hand to the stone.
sentences.cn: 我把自己的手贴在了石头上。

sentences.en: It was already cold.
sentences.cn: 石头已经很冷了。

sentences.en: She said nothing.
sentences.cn: 她什么都没说。

sentences.en: Neither did I.
sentences.cn: 我也没说。

period:2.en: Shen Wujiu spread three open books on the table, each covering one *period* of the sect's history. 'Every great trial falls at the end of a period,' he said. 'We are at the end of the third.' He tapped the final page of the last book. It was blank — not unwritten, but erased, as though someone had chosen not to record what came next.
period:2.cnHint: 师兄以三卷史书说明，每段历史____的末尾都有天劫降临，第三卷最后一页却是空白。
period:2.hook: The blank page held the faint ghost of vanished words.
period:2.line: 'Every *period* of our sect has ended with a trial like this.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu spread three open books on the table, each covering one *period* of the sect's history.
'Every great trial falls at the end of a period,' he said.
sentences.cn: "每一场大的试炼都发生在一个时期的末尾，"他说。

sentences.en: 'We are at the end of the third.'
sentences.cn: "我们正处于第三个时期的末尾。"

sentences.en: He tapped the final page of the last book.
sentences.cn: 他敲了敲最后一本书的最后一页。

sentences.en: It was blank — not unwritten, but erased, as though someone had chosen not to record what came next.
sentences.cn: 那一页是空白的——不是未曾写过，而是被擦掉了，仿佛有人选择不记录接下来发生的事。

picture:2.en: Inside the message tube I found a single folded paper. On it, Xiaoxing had made a small *picture* of our mountain in careful ink: the peak, the cloud gate, and one tiny figure standing at the edge. Below the figure she had written one word — 'ready.' I folded it back slowly, and when I looked up, the evening star had split in two.
picture:2.cnHint: 师妹在纸条上画了一幅____，图中山巅边缘立着一个小人，旁注'已准备好'，抬头时星辰已一分为二。
picture:2.hook: A star does not split unless the sky itself is cracking.
picture:2.line: 'I drew this *picture* so you would not forget what we are protecting.'

sentences.en: Inside the message tube I found a single folded paper.
sentences.cn: 我在信管里找到了一张折起的纸。

sentences.en: On it, Xiaoxing had made a small *picture* of our mountain in careful ink: the peak, the cloud gate, and one tiny figure standing at the edge.
Below the figure she had written one word — 'ready.'
sentences.cn: 纸下面她写了一个词——"准备好了"。

sentences.en: I folded it back slowly, and when I looked up, the evening star had split in two.
sentences.cn: 我慢慢地把它折回去，抬起头时，晚星已经裂成了两个。

relate:2.en: Deep inside the Archive Grotto, I found a cracked jade slip. When I pressed my fingers to its cool surface, broken images rose in my mind. I tried to *relate* every detail to Master Qingwu, but certain memories slipped away like mist the moment I opened my mouth.
relate:2.cnHint: 我在藏经洞发现一枚破损玉简，试图将其中的景象____给师尊，却发现记忆不断消散。
relate:2.hook: One image refused to leave: a door sealed with my own name.
relate:2.line: 'I can only *relate* what I saw before the vision went dark.'

sentences.en: Deep inside the Archive Grotto, I found a cracked jade slip.
sentences.cn: 我在藏经洞的深处找到了一块裂开的玉简。

sentences.en: When I pressed my fingers to its cool surface, broken images rose in my mind.
sentences.cn: 当我的手指按在它凉冰冰的表面上时，支离破碎的画面浮现在脑海里。

sentences.en: I tried to *relate* every detail to Master Qingwu, but certain memories slipped away like mist the moment I opened my mouth.

attitude:2.en: Shen Wujiu stood at the edge of the Observation Cliff, arms folded, back straight, his whole *attitude* that of someone carrying a weight no one else could see. I watched him in silence. Behind him, the sea of clouds churned in slow circles, and a single black feather drifted upward against the wind.
attitude:2.cnHint: 师兄站在悬崖边，他的整个____透露出一种难以言说的沉重。
attitude:2.hook: The feather rose higher than any feather should.
attitude:2.line: 'Your *attitude* toward the coming trial will decide everything.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu stood at the edge of the Observation Cliff, arms folded, back straight, his whole *attitude* that of someone carrying a weight no one else could see.
I watched him in silence.
sentences.cn: 我默默地看着他。

sentences.en: Behind him, the sea of clouds churned in slow circles, and a single black feather drifted upward against the wind.
sentences.cn: 他身后，云海在缓缓旋转，一根黑色的羽毛逆风向上飘去。

fill:2.en: Xiaoxing pressed a small amber vial into my hands near the Dew Stone Basin. 'Drink this,' she said softly. The warm liquid seemed to *fill* every hollow space inside my chest, steadying my breath. Outside the basin's ring of light, something large moved through the clouds below without making a sound.
fill:2.cnHint: 小星将药液递给我，那液体____了我胸中所有的空洞，让我平静下来。
fill:2.hook: Then the clouds parted, and the basin's reflection showed two moons.
fill:2.line: 'Let it *fill* the empty places before the trial begins.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing pressed a small amber vial into my hands near the Dew Stone Basin.
sentences.cn: 小杏在露石池边把一个小琥珀瓶塞进了我的手里。

sentences.en: 'Drink this,' she said softly.
sentences.cn: "喝了，"她轻声说。

sentences.en: The warm liquid seemed to *fill* every hollow space inside my chest, steadying my breath.
Outside the basin's ring of light, something large moved through the clouds below without making a sound.
sentences.cn: 在池子的光圈外，什么很大的东西在下面的云层里无声地移动。

ignore:2.en: A pale inscription had appeared overnight on the door of my meditation chamber. Every elder who passed by chose to *ignore* it, eyes sliding away as though the words caused them pain. I copied the inscription onto cloth with a trembling brush. Master Qingwu, reading it, did not speak for a very long time.
ignore:2.cnHint: 我门上出现的神秘铭文被所有长老____，只有师尊看后久久沉默。
ignore:2.hook: At last she folded the cloth and placed it inside her own robe.
ignore:2.line: 'We cannot *ignore* what the door has written for you.'

sentences.en: A pale inscription had appeared overnight on the door of my meditation chamber.
sentences.cn: 一行苍白的字迹在一夜间出现在了我禅房门上。

sentences.en: Every elder who passed by chose to *ignore* it, eyes sliding away as though the words caused them pain.
I copied the inscription onto cloth with a trembling brush.
sentences.cn: 我用颤抖的笔把那些字抄在布上。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu, reading it, did not speak for a very long time.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊读着，很久都没有说话。

necessary:2.en: Master Qingwu set three sealed spirit jars on the stone table before me. 'Take only what is *necessary*,' she said. Each jar hummed with a different colour of light — white, pale gold, and a deep red that pressed against its lid like something alive. I reached for the white one, then stopped.
necessary:2.cnHint: 师尊告诉我只取____的东西，但那三只灵罐各自散发出令人不安的光芒。
necessary:2.hook: The red jar's hum grew louder the moment my hand moved away.
necessary:2.line: 'Take only what is *necessary* — the trial punishes greed.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu set three sealed spirit jars on the stone table before me.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在石桌前放了三个密封的灵罐。

sentences.en: 'Take only what is *necessary*,' she said.
Each jar hummed with a different colour of light — white, pale gold, and a deep red that pressed against its lid like something alive.
sentences.cn: 每个罐子都散发出不同颜色的光——白色、淡金色，还有一种深红色，压在罐盖下像活的东西。

sentences.en: I reached for the white one, then stopped.
sentences.cn: 我伸手去拿白色的那个，然后停住了。

definitely:2.en: Shen Wujiu unrolled an old star chart across the worn floorboards of the map room. He traced a path with one finger and looked up at me. 'This route will *definitely* bring you past the Hollow Peak,' he said. Through the map room's single window, the peak in question was already wrapped in lightning.
definitely:2.cnHint: 师兄在地图室指出一条路线，说这条路____会经过空心峰，而那座山峰已被闪电笼罩。
definitely:2.hook: The lightning had no clouds above it to explain its presence.
definitely:2.line: 'This road will *definitely* lead you to what must be faced.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu unrolled an old star chart across the worn floorboards of the map room.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在地图室磨损的木板地上铺开了一张古老的星图。

sentences.en: He traced a path with one finger and looked up at me.
sentences.cn: 他用一根手指描过一条路线，抬头看我。

sentences.en: 'This route will *definitely* bring you past the Hollow Peak,' he said.
Through the map room's single window, the peak in question was already wrapped in lightning.
sentences.cn: 通过地图室唯一的窗口，那座山峰已经被闪电笼罩了。

forget:2.en: Near the Moss Bridge I found a small wooden tag hanging from a pine bough, my own handwriting on it. I had no memory of carving it. The tag read: do not *forget* the third bell. I counted the bells that had rung since dawn. There had only been two.
forget:2.cnHint: 我在苔桥附近发现一块刻有自己笔迹的木牌，提醒自己不要____第三声钟，但我完全不记得刻过它。
forget:2.hook: Somewhere below the clouds, a third bell began to toll.
forget:2.line: 'Whatever happens, do not *forget* the sound of the third bell.'

sentences.en: Near the Moss Bridge I found a small wooden tag hanging from a pine bough, my own handwriting on it.
sentences.cn: 我在苔藓桥附近从一棵松枝上找到了一个小木牌，上面是我自己的笔迹。

sentences.en: I had no memory of carving it.
sentences.cn: 我完全没有刻过它的记忆。

sentences.en: The tag read: do not *forget* the third bell.
I counted the bells that had rung since dawn.
sentences.cn: 我数了一下从天亮到现在敲响的钟声。

sentences.en: There had only been two.
sentences.cn: 只有两声。

particularly:2.en: The spirit compass Xiaoxing lent me behaved strangely all morning, spinning without reason. It was *particularly* restless when I carried it past the old willow at the sect's northern wall. I knelt and pressed my ear to the willow's bark. Inside, something was counting — slowly, steadily, in a voice not quite human.
particularly:2.cnHint: 小星借给我的灵罗盘整个上午都在乱转，尤其在经过北墙老柳时____不安分。
particularly:2.hook: It stopped counting at the exact number of days until the heavenly trial.
particularly:2.line: 'It is *particularly* active near the willow — that matters.'

sentences.en: The spirit compass Xiaoxing lent me behaved strangely all morning, spinning without reason.
sentences.cn: 小杏借给我的灵罗盘整个上午都表现得很奇怪，无缘无故地转动。

sentences.en: It was *particularly* restless when I carried it past the old willow at the sect's northern wall.
I knelt and pressed my ear to the willow's bark.
sentences.cn: 我跪下来，把耳朵贴在柳树的树皮上。

sentences.en: Inside, something was counting — slowly, steadily, in a voice not quite human.
sentences.cn: 里面有什么东西在数数——缓缓地，稳稳地，用一个不太像人类的声音。

return:2.en: Deep inside the Archive Grotto, I found an old scroll wedged behind a cracked stone shelf. It recorded the *return* of a lost disciple who had crossed the Cloud Boundary alone and come back changed — quieter, hollow-eyed, carrying herbs no one could name.
return:2.cnHint: 我在藏经洞深处发现一卷旧册，记载着某位弟子____后的异状。
return:2.hook: The scroll's final line had been torn away by careful hands.
return:2.line: Master Qingwu said, 'His *return* brought more questions than the journey ever answered.'

sentences.en: Deep inside the Archive Grotto, I found an old scroll wedged behind a cracked stone shelf.
sentences.cn: 在档案石窟的深处，我在一个裂开的石架后面找到了一卷老旧的卷轴。

sentences.en: It recorded the *return* of a lost disciple who had crossed the Cloud Boundary alone and come back changed — quieter, hollow-eyed, carrying herbs no one could name.

remove:2.en: Shen Wujiu knelt by the sect's offering stone and pressed his palm flat against a dark stain spreading across its surface. He told me the elders had tried everything to *remove* it, yet each morning the stain returned, wider and colder than before.
remove:2.cnHint: 师兄发现献石上的污渍无论如何都无法____。
remove:2.hook: Beneath my fingers the stone hummed, low and warning.
remove:2.line: Shen Wujiu said, 'We cannot *remove* what has already taken root.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu knelt by the sect's offering stone and pressed his palm flat against a dark stain spreading across its surface.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎跪在宗门的供奉石前，把手掌紧紧按在一片在其表面蔓延的黑色污渍上。

sentences.en: He told me the elders had tried everything to *remove* it, yet each morning the stain returned, wider and colder than before.

colleague:2.en: Master Qingwu unrolled a letter at the pavilion table, her face still. It was written by a *colleague* from the sister sect on the eastern peak, warning that three of their disciples had entered the Mist Trial and never spoken again — not dead, simply silent.
colleague:2.cnHint: 清雾师尊收到东峰一位____的来信，信中藏着令人不安的警示。
colleague:2.hook: The letter's ink smelled faintly of ash and crushed moongrass.
colleague:2.line: Master Qingwu said, 'My *colleague* does not frighten easily, yet she is frightened now.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu unrolled a letter at the pavilion table, her face still.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在亭子的桌子上展开了一封信，脸色很平静。

sentences.en: It was written by a *colleague* from the sister sect on the eastern peak, warning that three of their disciples had entered the Mist Trial and never spoken again — not dead, simply silent.

normal:2.en: Xiaoxing showed me the sect's weather stone, a pale sphere that glowed soft gold each dawn. For seven days it had shown only grey. She said nothing about it at breakfast, trying to keep her voice *normal*, but her hands would not stop tracing the stone's cold surface.
normal:2.cnHint: 小星努力让自己的状态看起来____，却掩不住内心的不安。
normal:2.hook: On the eighth morning, the stone showed no colour at all.
normal:2.line: Xiaoxing whispered, 'I keep telling myself this is *normal*, but I no longer believe it.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing showed me the sect's weather stone, a pale sphere that glowed soft gold each dawn.
sentences.cn: 小杏给我看了宗门的天气石，那是一个每天黎明时散发柔和金光的苍白球体。

sentences.en: For seven days it had shown only grey.
sentences.cn: 七天来它只显示灰色。

sentences.en: She said nothing about it at breakfast, trying to keep her voice *normal*, but her hands would not stop tracing the stone's cold surface.

succeed:2.en: Inside the Hall of Names I read the carved list of disciples who had attempted the Heaven Trial in past ages. Fewer than one in ten had managed to *succeed*. The names of those who failed were not erased — they were marked with a single small cloud, drifting.
succeed:2.cnHint: 在名册堂里，我得知历代试图通过天劫的弟子很少能够____。
succeed:2.hook: My own name, freshly cut, waited at the bottom of the stone.
succeed:2.line: Shen Wujiu said quietly, 'To *succeed* here, you must first let go of the wish to survive.'

sentences.en: Inside the Hall of Names I read the carved list of disciples who had attempted the Heaven Trial in past ages.
sentences.cn: 在名字堂里，我读到了过去年代尝试过天试的弟子们刻在名单上的名字。

sentences.en: Fewer than one in ten had managed to *succeed*.
The names of those who failed were not erased — they were marked with a single small cloud, drifting.
sentences.cn: 失败者的名字没有被擦掉——它们被标上一朵小小的漂浮云彩。

image:2.en: At the still pool behind the medicine garden, I looked down expecting my reflection. Instead the water showed a different *image* — a figure in white standing at the edge of a broken mountain, arms raised, clouds pouring upward from open palms like smoke from a quiet fire.
image:2.cnHint: 我在静水池中看到的____并不是自己的倒影。
image:2.hook: When I stepped back, the image stepped forward.
image:2.line: Master Qingwu said, 'That *image* is not a vision of the past — look again.'

sentences.en: At the still pool behind the medicine garden, I looked down expecting my reflection.
sentences.cn: 在药园后面的静池边，我低头看去，期待看到自己的倒影。

sentences.en: Instead the water showed a different *image* — a figure in white standing at the edge of a broken mountain, arms raised, clouds pouring upward from open palms like smoke from a quiet fire.

ourselves:2.en: Shen Wujiu and I sat on the outer terrace as the cloud sea turned the colour of old bronze below us. He said that the trial ahead was not made by the sect or the sky — we had shaped it *ourselves*, word by word, herb by herb, choice by slow choice.
ourselves:2.cnHint: 师兄告诉我，即将到来的考验其实是我们____一手造就的。
ourselves:2.hook: A single crane flew past, carrying something red in its beak.
ourselves:2.line: Shen Wujiu said, 'We built this path *ourselves*; we must walk it the same way.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu and I sat on the outer terrace as the cloud sea turned the colour of old bronze below us.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎和我坐在外面的露台上，云海在我们下方变成了古铜色。

sentences.en: He said that the trial ahead was not made by the sect or the sky — we had shaped it *ourselves*, word by word, herb by herb, choice by slow choice.

catch:2.en: Running through the Spiral Corridor before dawn, I nearly missed a tiny jade slip that had fallen from a message rack and lay face-down on the stone floor. I managed to *catch* it before it slid over the ledge — and read a name on its surface that stopped my breath.
catch:2.cnHint: 我在廊道中险些错过一枚玉简，幸好及时____住了它。
catch:2.hook: The name on the slip was mine, written in someone else's hand.
catch:2.line: Xiaoxing gasped, 'You were just in time to *catch* it — one breath later and it would be gone.'

sentences.en: Running through the Spiral Corridor before dawn, I nearly missed a tiny jade slip that had fallen from a message rack and lay face-down on the stone floor.
sentences.cn: 天亮前我在螺旋走廊里奔跑，差点没注意到一块从留言架上掉下来的小玉简，正面朝下地躺在石地上。

sentences.en: I managed to *catch* it before it slid over the ledge — and read a name on its surface that stopped my breath.

meanwhile:2.en: Master Qingwu handed me a sealed scroll at dawn and told me to guard it until the trial bell rang. I sat alone on the eastern ledge, watching the clouds shift below. *Meanwhile*, Shen Wujiu was somewhere on the western peak, learning the same formula from a different angle. Two paths, one truth — the sect always taught in pairs. Then the scroll grew warm in my hands.
meanwhile:2.cnHint: 师尊交给我一份密封的卷轴，让我守候；____，师兄在另一座山峰上学习同样的口诀。
meanwhile:2.hook: The warmth spread to my wrist, and the seal began to crack.
meanwhile:2.line: '*Meanwhile*, you must hold the scroll still — the formula feels every tremor.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu handed me a sealed scroll at dawn and told me to guard it until the trial bell rang.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在黎明时把一卷密封的卷轴递给我，告诉我要一直守护它直到试鼓敲响。

sentences.en: I sat alone on the eastern ledge, watching the clouds shift below.
sentences.cn: 我独自坐在东边的峭壁上，看着下方的云层变化。

sentences.en: *Meanwhile*, Shen Wujiu was somewhere on the western peak, learning the same formula from a different angle.
Two paths, one truth — the sect always taught in pairs.
sentences.cn: 两条路，一个真理——宗门总是成对教学。

sentences.en: Then the scroll grew warm in my hands.
sentences.cn: 然后卷轴在我手中变得滚烫。

damage:2.en: Xiaoxing found the old herb shelf in the storage cave and called me over with a soft whistle. Several clay jars had fallen, and the dried word-leaves inside were crushed beyond use. '*Damage* like this,' she said quietly, pressing a broken leaf between her fingers, 'means someone was searching, not stumbling.' The dust on the floor showed no foot marks at all.
damage:2.cnHint: 小星发现储藏洞里的草药架上有____，那些碎裂的叶片似乎不是意外造成的。
damage:2.hook: Above the empty shelf, a single character had been scratched into the stone.
damage:2.line: 'The *damage* to these leaves was done with purpose, not haste.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing found the old herb shelf in the storage cave and called me over with a soft whistle.
sentences.cn: 小杏在储存洞里找到了老药架，用轻轻的口哨声叫我过去。

sentences.en: Several clay jars had fallen, and the dried word-leaves inside were crushed beyond use. '*Damage* like this,' she said quietly, pressing a broken leaf between her fingers, 'means someone was searching, not stumbling.'
The dust on the floor showed no foot marks at all.
sentences.cn: 地上的灰尘根本看不到脚印。

police:2.en: In the sect's archive room hung an old painted scroll showing the four Guardian Words — ancient characters said to *police* the boundary between the floating mountains and the void below. Master Qingwu had spoken of them only once, in a tone that allowed no questions. Today the scroll was facing the wall. No one admitted to turning it.
police:2.cnHint: 藏经室里挂着记载四个守护字的古卷，据说它们能____云海宗与虚空之间的边界。
police:2.hook: When I reached out to turn the scroll back, my fingers went cold.
police:2.line: 'Those four words *police* the edge of our world — never speak them carelessly.'

sentences.en: In the sect's archive room hung an old painted scroll showing the four Guardian Words — ancient characters said to *police* the boundary between the floating mountains and the void below.
Master Qingwu had spoken of them only once, in a tone that allowed no questions.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊只说过一次，用一种不容许质疑的语气。

sentences.en: Today the scroll was facing the wall.
sentences.cn: 今天那卷轴面向了墙壁。

sentences.en: No one admitted to turning it.
sentences.cn: 没人承认转过它。

race:2.en: Shen Wujiu laid two glowing word-seeds on the stone table and said the test was simple: each seed would travel to the far lantern and back. The one that returned first would show which disciple had the cleaner breath-flow. I watched them *race* across the air in thin lines of light, neck and neck, until mine flickered once and fell still halfway. Shen Wujiu did not smile. That was almost worse.
race:2.cnHint: 我和师兄让两颗发光的字种____，以测试谁的气息更纯净，但我的字种中途熄灭了。
race:2.hook: Where my seed had stopped, a faint crack now split the stone floor.
race:2.line: 'Watch them *race* — the one that wavers first reveals the weaker will.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu laid two glowing word-seeds on the stone table and said the test was simple: each seed would travel to the far lantern and back.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎在石桌上摆了两颗闪闪发光的字籽，说考验很简单：每颗字籽都要飞到远处的灯笼再飞回来。

sentences.en: The one that returned first would show which disciple had the cleaner breath-flow.
sentences.cn: 先回来的那颗会显示哪个弟子的气流最清净。

sentences.en: I watched them *race* across the air in thin lines of light, neck and neck, until mine flickered once and fell still halfway.
Shen Wujiu did not smile.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎没有笑。

sentences.en: That was almost worse.
sentences.cn: 这反而更糟。

medical:2.en: Deep in the sect library, Xiaoxing showed me a chapter she had found: a *medical* text written in the old style, where each cure was a spoken word held at a precise pitch. 'Healers here don't mix roots,' she said, running her finger along the faded lines. 'They shape sound.' I had grown up thinking healing meant bitter tea and rest. The page turned on its own.
medical:2.cnHint: 小星在图书馆里找到了一部古老的____典籍，书中记载用特定音调发音来治愈疾病的方法。
medical:2.hook: The character for 'breath' at the bottom of the page was still wet with fresh ink.
medical:2.line: 'This *medical* knowledge was lost for three generations — guard it well.'

sentences.en: Deep in the sect library, Xiaoxing showed me a chapter she had found: a *medical* text written in the old style, where each cure was a spoken word held at a precise pitch.
'Healers here don't mix roots,' she said, running her finger along the faded lines.
sentences.cn: "这儿的医者不配方子，"小杏用手指沿着褪色的行字划过，说道。

sentences.en: 'They shape sound.'
sentences.cn: "他们塑造声音。"

sentences.en: I had grown up thinking healing meant bitter tea and rest.
sentences.cn: 我从小就以为治疗就是苦茶和休息。

sentences.en: The page turned on its own.
sentences.cn: 纸页自己翻开了。

wear:2.en: On the morning before the trial, Master Qingwu told me to *wear* the silver cord around my left wrist and not remove it until she said otherwise. It was thin enough to ignore, yet after an hour I felt it pulse faintly, like a second heartbeat slightly out of step with my own. Shen Wujiu glanced at it once but asked nothing. Some questions, I was learning, were themselves a test.
wear:2.cnHint: 青雾师尊让我____一根银色细绳在手腕上，它渐渐开始有了自己微弱的脉动。
wear:2.hook: By evening the cord had tightened one breath's width, all on its own.
wear:2.line: '*Wear* it close to the skin — it reads the words you have not yet spoken.'

sentences.en: On the morning before the trial, Master Qingwu told me to *wear* the silver cord around my left wrist and not remove it until she said otherwise.
It was thin enough to ignore, yet after an hour I felt it pulse faintly, like a second heartbeat slightly out of step with my own.
sentences.cn: 它细得可以忽略不计，可过了一小时我就感觉到它轻轻地跳动，像是与我自己的心跳略微错开的第二个心跳。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu glanced at it once but asked nothing.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎瞥了它一眼，但什么也没问。

sentences.en: Some questions, I was learning, were themselves a test.
sentences.cn: 我在学着，有些问题本身就是一场考验。

climate:2.en: The archive keeper told me that the *climate* inside the Word Vault was kept cold on purpose: warmth made the older characters restless, and restless characters rewrote themselves. He said it with the calm voice of someone stating an obvious fact. I pulled my robe tighter and looked at the rows of sealed jars breathing faint silver mist. Outside, the season was turning.
climate:2.cnHint: 档案守护者告诉我，字库里特意保持寒冷的____，因为温暖会让古老的字符自行改写。
climate:2.hook: One jar at the far end was already fogged on the inside, though none of us had breathed near it.
climate:2.line: 'The *climate* in this vault is a promise we make to the oldest words.'

sentences.en: The archive keeper told me that the *climate* inside the Word Vault was kept cold on purpose: warmth made the older characters restless, and restless characters rewrote themselves.
He said it with the calm voice of someone stating an obvious fact.
sentences.cn: 他用显然在陈述一个事实的平静嗓音说出这番话。

sentences.en: I pulled my robe tighter and looked at the rows of sealed jars breathing faint silver mist.
sentences.cn: 我把长袍拉紧，看着那一排排封闭的罐子呼出淡淡的银色雾气。

sentences.en: Outside, the season was turning.
sentences.cn: 外面，季节在转变。

head:2.en: Shen Wujiu told me to bow my *head* and listen to the mountain itself before I tried to read the root-formula carved at its base. I thought he was speaking in metaphor. Then I knelt, pressed my ear to the cold stone, and heard — very faintly, like a voice recalling something — the formula already moving beneath the rock, older than the sect, older than the cloud sea. I had not moved when he came back an hour later.
head:2.cnHint: 师兄让我低下____，去倾听山体本身，我竟真的听到了比宗门更古老的口诀在岩石下流动。
head:2.hook: When I finally lifted my head, my shadow was pointing the wrong direction.
head:2.line: 'Bow your *head* to the stone before you claim to understand what is written on it.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu told me to bow my *head* and listen to the mountain itself before I tried to read the root-formula carved at its base.
I thought he was speaking in metaphor.
sentences.cn: 我以为他在说比喻。

sentences.en: Then I knelt, pressed my ear to the cold stone, and heard — very faintly, like a voice recalling something — the formula already moving beneath the rock, older than the sect, older than the cloud sea.
sentences.cn: 然后我跪下，把耳朵贴在冰冷的石头上，听到了——很微弱，就像一个声音在回忆什么——根公式已经在岩石下流动，比宗门更古老，比云海更古老。

sentences.en: I had not moved when he came back an hour later.
sentences.cn: 一小时后他回来时，我还没动。

mistake:2.en: In the archive tower, I found an old scroll with my name on it. Someone had written a warning beside it: one *mistake* in copying the fire-word formula could reverse its meaning entirely, turning a healing herb into a poison. My hand had already moved. The ink was drying fast.
mistake:2.cnHint: 我在档案楼发现了一卷古籍，上面警告说抄录火字诀时一个____会让药草变成毒物。
mistake:2.hook: The ink dried — and the scroll began to smoke.
mistake:2.line: 'One *mistake* in that formula, and the mountain itself will reject you.'

sentences.en: In the archive tower, I found an old scroll with my name on it.
sentences.cn: 在档案塔里，我找到了一卷旧卷轴，上面写着我的名字。

sentences.en: Someone had written a warning beside it: one *mistake* in copying the fire-word formula could reverse its meaning entirely, turning a healing herb into a poison.
My hand had already moved.
sentences.cn: 我的手已经动了。

sentences.en: The ink was drying fast.
sentences.cn: 墨迹正在快速干燥。

staff:2.en: Master Qingwu gathered the full *staff* of Cloud Sea Sect at the Stone Altar before dawn. Every elder, every keeper of the word-gardens, every gate-warden stood still in the cold mist. She unrolled a pale ribbon and read from it without blinking. No one moved.
staff:2.cnHint: 清雾师尊在破晓前将云海宗所有____召集在石坛前，宣读了一道令人不安的卷轴。
staff:2.hook: When she finished reading, a single cloud rose straight up — against the wind.
staff:2.line: 'The full *staff* must hear this warning before the night passes.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu gathered the full *staff* of Cloud Sea Sect at the Stone Altar before dawn.
Every elder, every keeper of the word-gardens, every gate-warden stood still in the cold mist.
sentences.cn: 每个长老、字园的每个守护者、每个门卫都在冷雾中静静地站着。

sentences.en: She unrolled a pale ribbon and read from it without blinking.
sentences.cn: 她展开一条苍白的丝带，眼睛不眨地读了起来。

sentences.en: No one moved.
sentences.cn: 没人动。

enhance:2.en: Shen Wujiu pressed a small jade tablet into my palm. 'Breathe the word on its surface,' he said. I did, and felt the characters shift. The tablet could *enhance* the power of any spoken word by drawing spiritual energy from the breath itself. I whispered one test syllable — and the air cracked.
enhance:2.cnHint: 师兄给了我一块玉牌，说它能____任何口诵字诀的威力，我只低语了一个音节，空气便应声炸裂。
enhance:2.hook: Far below, something in the cloud sea stirred at that single syllable.
enhance:2.line: 'This stone will *enhance* your words — use it only when the need is real.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu pressed a small jade tablet into my palm.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎把一个小玉片按进了我的手心。

sentences.en: 'Breathe the word on its surface,' he said.
sentences.cn: "在它的表面呼出字来，"他说。

sentences.en: I did, and felt the characters shift.
sentences.cn: 我呼了，感觉到字符移动。

sentences.en: The tablet could *enhance* the power of any spoken word by drawing spiritual energy from the breath itself.
I whispered one test syllable — and the air cracked.
sentences.cn: 我低声说了一个测试音节——空气裂开了。

famous:2.en: Xiaoxing led me to a hidden garden where a single silver plant grew from bare stone. It was *famous* among disciples for appearing only once every sixty years, its leaves each carrying one complete healing word. She knelt beside it and listened, as if the plant was still speaking.
famous:2.cnHint: 师妹带我去看那株____的银草，据说每六十年才开放一次，叶片上藏有完整的治愈字诀。
famous:2.hook: As we knelt, the plant folded its leaves shut — all at once.
famous:2.line: 'This herb is *famous* for choosing its own reader — not every disciple may touch it.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing led me to a hidden garden where a single silver plant grew from bare stone.
sentences.cn: 小杏把我带到一个隐蔽的花园，那儿有一株银色的植物从赤裸的石头上生长出来。

sentences.en: It was *famous* among disciples for appearing only once every sixty years, its leaves each carrying one complete healing word.
She knelt beside it and listened, as if the plant was still speaking.
sentences.cn: 她跪在它旁边，如同在倾听，仿佛这株植物还在说话。

project:2.en: Master Qingwu assigned me a solo *project*: map every spiritual word carved into the East Cliff before the next dark moon. The carvings were old, some half-eaten by wind. I pressed paper against the stone and began. On the seventh sheet, a carving moved under my fingers.
project:2.cnHint: 清雾师尊交给我一项独自完成的____：在下次暗月前拓印东崖所有灵字，第七张拓纸下的刻文却动了起来。
project:2.hook: The moving carving left no mark on the paper — only on my skin.
project:2.line: 'Your *project* ends at the dark moon — what you find before then is yours to keep.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu assigned me a solo *project*: map every spiritual word carved into the East Cliff before the next dark moon.
The carvings were old, some half-eaten by wind.
sentences.cn: 这些雕刻很古老，有些被风吃掉了一半。

sentences.en: I pressed paper against the stone and began.
sentences.cn: 我把纸贴在石头上开始了。

sentences.en: On the seventh sheet, a carving moved under my fingers.
sentences.cn: 在第七张纸上，一个雕刻在我的手指下移动了。

record:2.en: In the inner hall I found a thin book: the *record* of every disciple who had attempted the Cloud Word Trial. Most names ended with a small red mark. Shen Wujiu's name was there, unmarked. Mine was already written on the last blank line, in ink that was not yet dry.
record:2.cnHint: 在内堂，我发现了一本记载云字试炼历代弟子的____，最后一行空白处已经写好了我的名字，墨迹未干。
record:2.hook: The book closed on its own — and the lock clicked from the inside.
record:2.line: 'The *record* never lies — every disciple who entered that hall is listed here.'

sentences.en: In the inner hall I found a thin book: the *record* of every disciple who had attempted the Cloud Word Trial.
Most names ended with a small red mark.
sentences.cn: 大多数名字后面都有一个小红点。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu's name was there, unmarked.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎的名字在那儿，没有标记。

sentences.en: Mine was already written on the last blank line, in ink that was not yet dry.
sentences.cn: 我的名字已经写在最后一个空白行上，用的是还没干的墨水。

regular:2.en: Shen Wujiu told me the stone bridge between the two peaks held up only because of a *regular* offering of spoken words at dawn — one disciple each morning, one syllable at a time, feeding the bridge its spiritual balance. This morning, no one had come. The bridge was already humming.
regular:2.cnHint: 师兄告诉我，连接两峰的石桥需要每天清晨____诵字供养才能维持平衡，而今晨无人前来，桥身已开始震鸣。
regular:2.hook: The humming rose to a note I felt in my teeth, not my ears.
regular:2.line: 'A *regular* offering at dawn is all that keeps this bridge from folding into the clouds.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu told me the stone bridge between the two peaks held up only because of a *regular* offering of spoken words at dawn — one disciple each morning, one syllable at a time, feeding the bridge its spiritual balance.
This morning, no one had come.
sentences.cn: 今早没人来。

sentences.en: The bridge was already humming.
sentences.cn: 这座桥已经在嗡嗡作响了。

security:2.en: At the outer gate, Xiaoxing showed me the word-seal that provided *security* for the whole mountain — a layered formula carved into the archway, renewed each season. She pressed her finger to one edge and frowned. A thin line of the carving had gone dark, like a lamp with no oil left.
security:2.cnHint: 师妹带我查看山门的封字阵法，这道为全山提供____的阵法有一道细纹已经暗掉，如同油尽的灯。
security:2.hook: Behind us, a wind came up from below the clouds — cold, and smelling of nothing at all.
security:2.line: 'Without this seal, the *security* of every disciple on this mountain rests on nothing but hope.'

sentences.en: At the outer gate, Xiaoxing showed me the word-seal that provided *security* for the whole mountain — a layered formula carved into the archway, renewed each season.
She pressed her finger to one edge and frowned.
sentences.cn: 她用一根手指按住边缘，皱起了眉头。

sentences.en: A thin line of the carving had gone dark, like a lamp with no oil left.
sentences.cn: 雕刻线的一处已经变暗了，像一盏没有油的灯。

whatever:2.en: Shen Wujiu spread the old scroll on the stone table and traced each line with one finger. 'Copy *whatever* words glow when the mountain shakes,' he said quietly. I pressed my brush to the page. Three words shone at once — far more than anyone had warned us to expect.
whatever:2.cnHint: 师兄告诉我，山体震动时，把____发光的字全部抄下来。
whatever:2.hook: The three glowing words had never appeared together in any known formula.
whatever:2.line: 'Copy *whatever* words glow, and do not stop your brush.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu spread the old scroll on the stone table and traced each line with one finger.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎把旧卷轴铺在石桌上，用一根手指描着每一行。
